   - FIMC-IS firmware version check hard-failed on `/system/vendor/firmware`;
     add a `request_firmware()` fallback so `/lib/firmware` works.
3. `parity/patches/drm/0001-drm-exynos7580-decon-dsim-kms.patch`
   - new `drivers/gpu/drm/exynos7580/` KMS driver (DECON + DSIM + ea8061).
4. `parity/patches/drm/0002-arm64-dts-exynos7580-j7elte-drm-display.patch`
   - DT compatibles for the DRM driver on rev00/04/06.

pmaports (apply in this order to `parity/pmaports`, baseline `ba682bd`):

5. `parity/patches/wifi/0001-j7elte-wifi-firmware-paths.patch`
   - `BCMDHD_FW_PATH` / `BCMDHD_NVRAM_PATH` -> `/lib/firmware/postmarketos/samsung-j7elte/`.
6. `parity/patches/bluetooth/0002-j7elte-bt-hci-config.patch`
   - enable `CONFIG_BT_HCIUART` + `CONFIG_BT_HCIUART_H4` for BlueZ.
7. `parity/patches/pmaports/0003-firmware-samsung-j7elte-package.patch`
   - new `firmware-samsung-j7elte` package (Wi-Fi, BT, FIMC-IS, MFC blobs).
8. `parity/patches/pmaports/0005-linux-samsung-j7elte-config-sha512.patch`
   - updated config checksum after the two config changes.
9. `parity/patches/userspace/0001-device-deps.patch`
   - `device-samsung-j7elte` depends on the firmware and all userspace packages.
10. `parity/patches/userspace/audio/0002-j7elte-audio-ucm-package.patch`
11. `parity/patches/userspace/connectivity/0001-j7elte-wifi-package.patch`
12. `parity/patches/userspace/connectivity/0002-j7elte-bt-package.patch`
13. `parity/patches/userspace/sensors/0001-add-j7elte-sensors-package.patch`
14. `parity/patches/userspace/battery/0001-pmaports-add-j7elte-power-package.patch`
15. `parity/patches/userspace/gps/0001-pmaports-add-j7elte-gpsd-package.patch`
16. `parity/patches/userspace/ril/0001-j7elte-cbd-package.patch`
17. `parity/patches/userspace/camera/0001-pmaports-add-j7elte-cam-package.patch`
18. `parity/patches/userspace/fde/0001-j7elte-fde-package.patch`
19. `parity/patches/userspace/gpu/0001-j7elte-gpu-soft-package.patch`
   - software GL (Mesa llvmpipe + Xorg fbdev); pulled in by the device package.

The GPS daemon source is also exported as
`parity/patches/userspace/gps/0002-userspace-add-j7elte-gpsd-source.patch`
(source tree; `verify.sh` skips it because it targets `parity/userspace/`).

DRM config fragment (opt-in, used for the final build):
`parity/patches/drm/config-drm-exynos7580.fragment`.

Verify everything:

```
cd parity
./verify.sh          # 22 patches OK; 2 skipped (source-tree + dependent fix)
```

## Build

Base build (vendor fbdev display, camera + BT patches):

```
./parity/build.sh parity/build-src parity/out Image dtbs
```

Result: `BUILD_EXIT=0`, Image 17,365,040 B, three j7elte DTBs under `parity/out/`.

Final combined build (adds the DRM/KMS driver; opt-in config):

```
CFG=parity/final-config ./parity/build.sh parity/final-kernel-check parity/final-out Image dtbs
```

- `parity/final-kernel-check` is a clean `b5e363a` worktree with the pmaports
  build patches (GCC 10, fix-argb, sun/Solaris flag, etc.) plus the Bluetooth,
  camera and DRM kernel patches.
- `parity/final-config` is the WiFi/BT kernel config plus
  `parity/patches/drm/config-drm-exynos7580.fragment` (DRM, 32 MB CMA, vendor
  fbdev display path disabled).
- Result: `BUILD_EXIT=0`, Image **17,545,608 B**, three j7elte DTBs under
  `parity/final-out/`, `exynos7580_{drm,decon,dsim}.o` built, camera fallback
  and BT `gpc4-2` group present in the outputs.

Keep the vendor fbdev path as the fallback; do not enable both display stacks
at once.

## Firmware package

`parity/pmaports/device/archived/firmware-samsung-j7elte/` contains:

- `APKBUILD` (deterministic `firmware.tar.gz`, sha512 pinned)
- `extract-firmware.sh` (rebuilds the tarball from the stock AP tar; verifies `files.sha512`)
- `files.sha512` (per-blob checksums)

Install destinations:

- `/lib/firmware/postmarketos/samsung-j7elte/` - bcmdhd firmware/NVRAM, BT HCD
- `/lib/firmware/` - `fimc_is_fw2_3l2.bin`, `setfile_3l2.bin`, `setfile_5e3.bin`,
  `fimc_is_fd.bin`, `mfc_fw.bin`

## Kernel driver parity (first round)

- 11 driver families at parity: display, battery, audio, sensors, storage, touch,
  USB, GPS, GPU, platform (thermal/devfreq/IOMMU/cpufreq), modem.
- 3 driver families patched: Wi-Fi (config), Bluetooth (DT + config), camera (driver fallback).
- The ROM's driver set is already present in the Nura fork; no driver code was missing
  for those families.

## New DRM/KMS driver (display)

- `parity/patches/drm/0001-drm-exynos7580-decon-dsim-kms.patch`
  adds `drivers/gpu/drm/exynos7580/` (DECON CRTC/plane, DSIM encoder/connector,
  ea8061 panel init, dumb buffers + fbdev).
- `parity/patches/drm/0002-arm64-dts-exynos7580-j7elte-drm-display.patch`
  adds `samsung,exynos7580-decon-drm` / `samsung,exynos7580-dsim` to rev00/04/06.
- `parity/patches/drm/config-drm-exynos7580.fragment` enables DRM,
  `CONFIG_DRM_EXYNOS7580`, 32 MB CMA, and disables the vendor fbdev display path.
- Verified build: `parity/final-out/arch/arm64/boot/Image` (17,545,608 B) + three
  j7elte DTBs; `exynos7580_{drm,decon,dsim}.o` are built and the DTBs contain the
  new compatibles.
- Hardware-untested. Keep the vendor fbdev driver as the fallback until a real
  modeset is validated on the phone.

## Userspace gap packages

New pmaports packages, all pulled in by `device-samsung-j7elte` depends:

| Package | Gap | Status |
|---|---|---|
| `j7elte-audio-ucm` | UCM2 routing/mixer for COD3022X (54/54 controls validated) | implemented |
| `j7elte-audio-jack` | `sec_jack` uevent -> UCM2 speaker/headphone/headset-mic routing | implemented |
| `j7elte-wifi` | wpa_supplicant template, `/efs/wifi` MAC provisioning | implemented |
| `j7elte-bt` | rfkill + hciattach + bluetoothd service, BCM43438A1.hcd | implemented |
| `j7elte-sensors` | K2HH/CM36672P/STK3013 to `net.hadess.SensorProxy`; D-Bus UNIX_FDS fix | implemented |
| `j7elte-power` | power_supply/UPower integration, capacity_max restore | implemented |
| `j7elte-fde` | unl0kr/fbdev initramfs integration for FDE | implemented |
| `j7elte-gpu-soft` | Mesa llvmpipe + Xorg fbdev software GL (installed by device package) | implemented (software only) |
| `j7elte-gpsd` | BCM4752 power + NMEA PTY/socket forwarder | partial: init protocol blocked |
| `j7elte-cam` | V4L2 capture + optional AE/AWB metadata loop | implemented (basic capture + AE; no JPEG/3A HAL) |
| `j7elte-cbd` | CP boot loader for `/dev/umts_boot0` | partial: RIL layer blocked |
| `j7elte-ril` | SIPC5 transport, IMEI, SIM lock, network state | partial: calls/SMS/data not implemented |
| `firmware-samsung-j7elte` | Wi-Fi/BT/FIMC-IS/MFC blobs | implemented |

Details and test plans are in `parity/reports/*-userspace.md`.

## Second-round verification

- 18 pmaports patches (firmware, kernel config, all userspace packages, RIL,
  audio jack, the dependent sensor D-Bus fix, and device deps) apply cleanly in
  order to a fresh `ba682bd` worktree.
- Combined kernel build with camera + Bluetooth + DRM patches and the DRM config
  fragment: `BUILD_EXIT=0`, `Image` 17,545,608 B, three DTBs.
- The built Image contains the camera `request_firmware` fallback and the
  `samsung,exynos7580-decon-drm` compatible; the built DTB routes `bluetooth`
  pinctrl to `gpc4-2` and contains the DRM display compatibles.
- Verification is static plus cross-build; no phone was available for runtime tests.

## Remaining blockers

- **GPU / 3D (hardware)**: the kernel exposes only kbase; Mesa/Panfrost needs a
  mainline DRM driver. No Linux Mali-T720 userspace exists for this kernel.
  Software rendering is packaged as `j7elte-gpu-soft` (installed by the device
  package, llvmpipe + Xorg fbdev); it is not Mali acceleration.
- **Telephony (calls/SMS/data)**: the CP loader is implemented and dry-run verified,
  but the Samsung SIPC5 RIL is proprietary and undocumented.
- **GPS**: power/NMEA forwarding works, but the BCM4752 init exchange is proprietary;
  a hardware capture is required to finish it.
- **Camera**: basic capture only; 3A/JPEG HAL is not implemented.
- **Display**: the DRM/KMS driver compiles; a hardware modeset is still untested.

## Notes

- The original stock zip remains at `/home/asdf/Downloads/SAMFW.COM_SM-J700M_PCW_J700MUBU2BRC2_fac.zip`.
- 218 scratch entries moved from `/tmp` to `session/tmp-artifacts/` (see `MANIFEST.txt`).
- Verification is static plus cross-build; no runtime test on the phone was possible here.

# j7elte ROM <-> Nura driver parity session

Working directory for the Samsung Galaxy J7 (2015) `SM-J700M` (`j7elte`, Exynos 7580)
kernel driver parity work between the stock Android ROM and Nura (formerly postmarketOS).

## Device / sources

- Stock ROM: `SM-J700M` `J700MUBU2BRC2`, Android 6.0.1, kernel `3.10.61-13213628`.
- ROM kernel: raw arm64 `Image`, all drivers built in (no `.ko` modules),
  55,634 kallsyms symbols recovered.
- Nura kernel: `LineageOS/android_kernel_samsung_universal7580` @ `2a746c1`,
  downstream 3.10.108, baseline commit `b5e363a`. Nura is **not** mainline for this device.
- Upstream reference: Linux 7.3 (kernel.org), used only for the parity survey.

## Layout

```
boot.img, recovery.img, system.img, system.raw   extracted ROM images
AP_J700MUBU2BRC2_..._user_low_ship.tar.md5       AP tar (extracted from the stock zip)
boot_out/                                        kernel.bin, vmlinux.elf, symbols.txt, dtbs/
android_kernel_samsung_universal7580-.../         Nura kernel tree (clean baseline)
linux-7.3/, linux-7.3.tar.xz                      upstream reference
toolchains/                                       GCC 10.3 aarch64 toolchain
config-nura-j7elte                                Nura build config (pristine)
lineage-kernel.tar.gz                             Nura kernel source archive
tools/                                            boot image / config comparison helpers
session/tmp-artifacts/                            scratch files moved out of /tmp
parity/                                           all deliverables (see below)
```

`parity/`:

```
patches/          7 exported patches (kernel + pmaports)
reports/          14 per-driver reports (P1-P4 evidence)
firmware/         extracted ROM blobs + per-driver file lists + MANIFEST.sha512
pmaports/         pmaports baseline ba682bd + uncommitted integration changes
build-src/        kernel worktree with build patches + parity kernel patches applied
out/              built Image and rev00/rev04/rev06 DTBs
build.sh          kernel build script (GCC 10.3)
verify.sh         applies every patch with git apply --check against the baselines
contract.md       parity definition and evidence rules
*.log             baseline / camera / final build logs
```

## Patches

Kernel (apply to the baseline kernel tree, commit `b5e363a`):

1. `parity/patches/bluetooth/0001-j7elte-bt-pinctrl.patch`
   - BT enable pin was `gpa1-6`; ROM uses `gpc4-2` on all three board revisions.
2. `parity/patches/camera/0001-fimc-is2-fallback-to-request_firmware-for-fw-version-check.patch`
   - FIMC-IS firmware version check hard-failed on `/system/vendor/firmware`;
     add a `request_firmware()` fallback so `/lib/firmware` works.
3. `parity/patches/drm/0001-drm-exynos7580-decon-dsim-kms.patch`
   - new `drivers/gpu/drm/exynos7580/` KMS driver (DECON + DSIM + ea8061).
4. `parity/patches/drm/0002-arm64-dts-exynos7580-j7elte-drm-display.patch`
   - DT compatibles for the DRM driver on rev00/04/06.

pmaports (apply in this order to `parity/pmaports`, baseline `ba682bd`):

5. `parity/patches/wifi/0001-j7elte-wifi-firmware-paths.patch`
   - `BCMDHD_FW_PATH` / `BCMDHD_NVRAM_PATH` -> `/lib/firmware/postmarketos/samsung-j7elte/`.
6. `parity/patches/bluetooth/0002-j7elte-bt-hci-config.patch`
   - enable `CONFIG_BT_HCIUART` + `CONFIG_BT_HCIUART_H4` for BlueZ.
7. `parity/patches/pmaports/0003-firmware-samsung-j7elte-package.patch`
   - new `firmware-samsung-j7elte` package (Wi-Fi, BT, FIMC-IS, MFC blobs).
8. `parity/patches/pmaports/0005-linux-samsung-j7elte-config-sha512.patch`
   - updated config checksum after the two config changes.
9. `parity/patches/userspace/0001-device-deps.patch`
   - `device-samsung-j7elte` depends on the firmware and all userspace packages.
10. `parity/patches/userspace/audio/0002-j7elte-audio-ucm-package.patch`
11. `parity/patches/userspace/connectivity/0001-j7elte-wifi-package.patch`
12. `parity/patches/userspace/connectivity/0002-j7elte-bt-package.patch`
13. `parity/patches/userspace/sensors/0001-add-j7elte-sensors-package.patch`
14. `parity/patches/userspace/battery/0001-pmaports-add-j7elte-power-package.patch`
15. `parity/patches/userspace/gps/0001-pmaports-add-j7elte-gpsd-package.patch`
16. `parity/patches/userspace/ril/0001-j7elte-cbd-package.patch`
17. `parity/patches/userspace/camera/0001-pmaports-add-j7elte-cam-package.patch`

== gps verdict ==
# BCM4752 init implementation in `j7elte-gpsd` (RE + build evidence)

**Verdict: PARTIAL, but the first two handshake exchanges are now byte-exact.**
The autobaud burst and three command frames (`Bri_GetOutOfLegacy`,
`Bri_RequestHwVersion`, `Bri_RequestDebugSfr`) were recovered from
`/system/bin/gpsd` down to the individual bytes and are sent by
`j7elte-gpsd --init`, with the vendor's own timeouts and retry schedule.
The sequence then stops deliberately at the first step whose bytes cannot be
derived statically (`Bri_ProgramSwFlowControl`), because that step *searches*
for a working escape-byte pair instead of emitting a fixed frame.

Everything below is cross-compilation, disassembly and an off-target test with
a PTY emulating the chip under `qemu-aarch64`. No hardware was available, so no
claim is made about what the real BCM4752 answers.

## 1. How the code was located (method)

* Binary: `/system/bin/gpsd` (4,059,464 B, ELF32 ARM EABI5, PIE linked at 0,
  stripped, `.text` @0x18990, `.rodata` @0x2f0570). File offsets equal
  virtual addresses for `.text`/`.rodata`; `.data.rel.ro`/`.got`/`.data` are
  shifted by 0x1000.
* Ghidra 12.1.2 headless (`-processor ARM:LE:32:v7`) gives the function map,
  but **plain pointer scans find no references to any of the log/format
  strings**. The build (Android NDK, `-mword-relocations` off) addresses
  `.rodata` through the Thumb-2 PIC idiom

  ```
  ldr  r3, [pc, #imm]      ; literal = target - (pc_of_add + 4)
  add  r3, pc              ; r3 = absolute target
  ```

  so the literal pool holds a *PC-relative delta*, not an absolute address.
  A scanner for `ldr rX,[pc,#imm]` immediately followed by `add rX, pc`
  recovers 31,384 rodata references and that is what maps every string to its
  function (e.g. `0x34c764 "GlMeSrdAsicinit::Bri_SendAutobaud()"` ← site
  `0x2a5b3a` in `FUN_002a5b58`). Without this step the image looks like it
  contains no GPS strings at all.
* Function boundaries come from `.ARM.exidx` (9,562 entries), which is more
  reliable than Ghidra here: several functions overlap in Ghidra's view, so
  disassembly was done with capstone/objdump (`-M force-thumb -m arm`) over
  the exidx ranges.
* The PLT is 12-byte stubs (`add ip,pc,#0x300000; add ip,ip,#0xNM000;
  ldr pc,[ip,#imm]!`), so GOT slot = `stub + 8 + 0x3c2000 + imm`. This is how
  `0x17af0` was proven to be `memset` (GOT 0x3d9b20) and not `__errno`, which
  matters for reading the autobaud code.

# j7elte ROM <-> Nura driver parity session

Working directory for the Samsung Galaxy J7 (2015) `SM-J700M` (`j7elte`, Exynos 7580)
kernel driver parity work between the stock Android ROM and Nura (formerly postmarketOS).

## Device / sources

- Stock ROM: `SM-J700M` `J700MUBU2BRC2`, Android 6.0.1, kernel `3.10.61-13213628`.
- ROM kernel: raw arm64 `Image`, all drivers built in (no `.ko` modules),
  55,634 kallsyms symbols recovered.
- Nura kernel: `LineageOS/android_kernel_samsung_universal7580` @ `2a746c1`,
  downstream 3.10.108, baseline commit `b5e363a`. Nura is **not** mainline for this device.
- Upstream reference: Linux 7.3 (kernel.org), used only for the parity survey.

## Layout

```
boot.img, recovery.img, system.img, system.raw   extracted ROM images
AP_J700MUBU2BRC2_..._user_low_ship.tar.md5       AP tar (extracted from the stock zip)
boot_out/                                        kernel.bin, vmlinux.elf, symbols.txt, dtbs/
android_kernel_samsung_universal7580-.../         Nura kernel tree (clean baseline)
linux-7.3/, linux-7.3.tar.xz                      upstream reference
toolchains/                                       GCC 10.3 aarch64 toolchain
config-nura-j7elte                                Nura build config (pristine)
lineage-kernel.tar.gz                             Nura kernel source archive
tools/                                            boot image / config comparison helpers
session/tmp-artifacts/                            scratch files moved out of /tmp
parity/                                           all deliverables (see below)
```

`parity/`:

```
patches/          7 exported patches (kernel + pmaports)
reports/          14 per-driver reports (P1-P4 evidence)
firmware/         extracted ROM blobs + per-driver file lists + MANIFEST.sha512
pmaports/         pmaports baseline ba682bd + uncommitted integration changes
build-src/        kernel worktree with build patches + parity kernel patches applied
out/              built Image and rev00/rev04/rev06 DTBs
build.sh          kernel build script (GCC 10.3)
verify.sh         applies every patch with git apply --check against the baselines
contract.md       parity definition and evidence rules
*.log             baseline / camera / final build logs
```

## Patches

Kernel (apply to the baseline kernel tree, commit `b5e363a`):

1. `parity/patches/bluetooth/0001-j7elte-bt-pinctrl.patch`
   - BT enable pin was `gpa1-6`; ROM uses `gpc4-2` on all three board revisions.
2. `parity/patches/camera/0001-fimc-is2-fallback-to-request_firmware-for-fw-version-check.patch`
   - FIMC-IS firmware version check hard-failed on `/system/vendor/firmware`;
     add a `request_firmware()` fallback so `/lib/firmware` works.
3. `parity/patches/drm/0001-drm-exynos7580-decon-dsim-kms.patch`
   - new `drivers/gpu/drm/exynos7580/` KMS driver (DECON + DSIM + ea8061).
4. `parity/patches/drm/0002-arm64-dts-exynos7580-j7elte-drm-display.patch`
   - DT compatibles for the DRM driver on rev00/04/06.

pmaports (apply in this order to `parity/pmaports`, baseline `ba682bd`):

5. `parity/patches/wifi/0001-j7elte-wifi-firmware-paths.patch`
   - `BCMDHD_FW_PATH` / `BCMDHD_NVRAM_PATH` -> `/lib/firmware/postmarketos/samsung-j7elte/`.
6. `parity/patches/bluetooth/0002-j7elte-bt-hci-config.patch`
   - enable `CONFIG_BT_HCIUART` + `CONFIG_BT_HCIUART_H4` for BlueZ.
7. `parity/patches/pmaports/0003-firmware-samsung-j7elte-package.patch`
   - new `firmware-samsung-j7elte` package (Wi-Fi, BT, FIMC-IS, MFC blobs).
8. `parity/patches/pmaports/0005-linux-samsung-j7elte-config-sha512.patch`
   - updated config checksum after the two config changes.
9. `parity/patches/userspace/0001-device-deps.patch`
   - `device-samsung-j7elte` depends on the firmware and all userspace packages.
10. `parity/patches/userspace/audio/0002-j7elte-audio-ucm-package.patch`
11. `parity/patches/userspace/connectivity/0001-j7elte-wifi-package.patch`
12. `parity/patches/userspace/connectivity/0002-j7elte-bt-package.patch`
13. `parity/patches/userspace/sensors/0001-add-j7elte-sensors-package.patch`
14. `parity/patches/userspace/battery/0001-pmaports-add-j7elte-power-package.patch`
15. `parity/patches/userspace/gps/0001-pmaports-add-j7elte-gpsd-package.patch`
16. `parity/patches/userspace/ril/0001-j7elte-cbd-package.patch`
17. `parity/patches/userspace/camera/0001-pmaports-add-j7elte-cam-package.patch`
18. `parity/patches/userspace/fde/0001-j7elte-fde-package.patch`
19. `parity/patches/userspace/gpu/0001-j7elte-gpu-soft-package.patch`
   - software GL (Mesa llvmpipe + Xorg fbdev); pulled in by the device package.
20. `parity/patches/userspace/audio/0003-j7elte-audio-jack-package.patch`
21. `parity/patches/userspace/ril/0002-j7elte-ril-package.patch`

Dependent/optional patches:
- `parity/patches/userspace/review-a/0001-j7elte-sensors-ignore-unknown-dbus-header-fields.patch`
  (apply after `sensors/0001`; required for GDBus clients)
- `parity/patches/userspace/gpu-panfrost/0001-arm64-dts-exynos7580-add-mali-t720-compatible.patch`
  (optional kernel DT string for a future Panfrost driver; kbase still binds)

The GPS daemon source is also exported as
`parity/patches/userspace/gps/0002-userspace-add-j7elte-gpsd-source.patch`
(source tree; `verify.sh` skips it because it targets `parity/userspace/`).

DRM config fragment (opt-in, used for the final build):
`parity/patches/drm/config-drm-exynos7580.fragment`.

Verify everything:

```
cd parity
./verify.sh          # 22 patches OK; 2 skipped (source-tree + dependent fix)
```

## Build

Base build (vendor fbdev display, camera + BT patches):

```
./parity/build.sh parity/build-src parity/out Image dtbs
```

Result: `BUILD_EXIT=0`, Image 17,365,040 B, three j7elte DTBs under `parity/out/`.

Final combined build (adds the DRM/KMS driver; opt-in config):

```
CFG=parity/final-config ./parity/build.sh parity/final-kernel-check parity/final-out Image dtbs
```

- `parity/final-kernel-check` is a clean `b5e363a` worktree with the pmaports
  build patches (GCC 10, fix-argb, sun/Solaris flag, etc.) plus the Bluetooth,
  camera and DRM kernel patches.
- `parity/final-config` is the WiFi/BT kernel config plus
  `parity/patches/drm/config-drm-exynos7580.fragment` (DRM, 32 MB CMA, vendor
  fbdev display path disabled).
- Result: `BUILD_EXIT=0`, Image **17,545,608 B**, three j7elte DTBs under
  `parity/final-out/`, `exynos7580_{drm,decon,dsim}.o` built, camera fallback
  and BT `gpc4-2` group present in the outputs.

Keep the vendor fbdev path as the fallback; do not enable both display stacks
at once.

## Firmware package

`parity/pmaports/device/archived/firmware-samsung-j7elte/` contains:

- `APKBUILD` (deterministic `firmware.tar.gz`, sha512 pinned)
- `extract-firmware.sh` (rebuilds the tarball from the stock AP tar; verifies `files.sha512`)
- `files.sha512` (per-blob checksums)

Install destinations:

- `/lib/firmware/postmarketos/samsung-j7elte/` - bcmdhd firmware/NVRAM, BT HCD
- `/lib/firmware/` - `fimc_is_fw2_3l2.bin`, `setfile_3l2.bin`, `setfile_5e3.bin`,
  `fimc_is_fd.bin`, `mfc_fw.bin`

## Kernel driver parity (first round)

- 11 driver families at parity: display, battery, audio, sensors, storage, touch,
  USB, GPS, GPU, platform (thermal/devfreq/IOMMU/cpufreq), modem.
- 3 driver families patched: Wi-Fi (config), Bluetooth (DT + config), camera (driver fallback).
- The ROM's driver set is already present in the Nura fork; no driver code was missing
  for those families.

## New DRM/KMS driver (display)

- `parity/patches/drm/0001-drm-exynos7580-decon-dsim-kms.patch`
  adds `drivers/gpu/drm/exynos7580/` (DECON CRTC/plane, DSIM encoder/connector,
  ea8061 panel init, dumb buffers + fbdev).
- `parity/patches/drm/0002-arm64-dts-exynos7580-j7elte-drm-display.patch`
  adds `samsung,exynos7580-decon-drm` / `samsung,exynos7580-dsim` to rev00/04/06.
- `parity/patches/drm/config-drm-exynos7580.fragment` enables DRM,
  `CONFIG_DRM_EXYNOS7580`, 32 MB CMA, and disables the vendor fbdev display path.
- Verified build: `parity/final-out/arch/arm64/boot/Image` (17,545,608 B) + three
  j7elte DTBs; `exynos7580_{drm,decon,dsim}.o` are built and the DTBs contain the
  new compatibles.
- Hardware-untested. Keep the vendor fbdev driver as the fallback until a real
  modeset is validated on the phone.

## Userspace gap packages

New pmaports packages, all pulled in by `device-samsung-j7elte` depends:

| Package | Gap | Status |
|---|---|---|
| `j7elte-audio-ucm` | UCM2 routing/mixer for COD3022X (54/54 controls validated) | implemented |
| `j7elte-audio-jack` | `sec_jack` uevent -> UCM2 speaker/headphone/headset-mic routing | implemented |
| `j7elte-wifi` | wpa_supplicant template, `/efs/wifi` MAC provisioning | implemented |
| `j7elte-bt` | rfkill + hciattach + bluetoothd service, BCM43438A1.hcd | implemented |
| `j7elte-sensors` | K2HH/CM36672P/STK3013 to `net.hadess.SensorProxy`; D-Bus UNIX_FDS fix | implemented |
| `j7elte-power` | power_supply/UPower integration, capacity_max restore | implemented |
| `j7elte-fde` | unl0kr/fbdev initramfs integration for FDE | implemented |
| `j7elte-gpu-soft` | Mesa llvmpipe + Xorg fbdev software GL (installed by device package) | implemented (software only) |
| `j7elte-gpsd` | BCM4752 power + NMEA PTY/socket forwarder | partial: init protocol blocked |
| `j7elte-cam` | V4L2 capture + optional AE/AWB metadata loop | implemented (basic capture + AE; no JPEG/3A HAL) |
| `j7elte-cbd` | CP boot loader for `/dev/umts_boot0` | partial: RIL layer blocked |
| `j7elte-ril` | SIPC5 transport, IMEI, SIM lock, network state | partial: calls/SMS/data not implemented |
| `firmware-samsung-j7elte` | Wi-Fi/BT/FIMC-IS/MFC blobs | implemented |

Details and test plans are in `parity/reports/*-userspace.md`.

## Second-round verification

- 18 pmaports patches (firmware, kernel config, all userspace packages, RIL,
  audio jack, the dependent sensor D-Bus fix, and device deps) apply cleanly in
  order to a fresh `ba682bd` worktree.
- Combined kernel build with camera + Bluetooth + DRM patches and the DRM config
  fragment: `BUILD_EXIT=0`, `Image` 17,545,608 B, three DTBs.
- The built Image contains the camera `request_firmware` fallback and the
  `samsung,exynos7580-decon-drm` compatible; the built DTB routes `bluetooth`
  pinctrl to `gpc4-2` and contains the DRM display compatibles.
- Verification is static plus cross-build; no phone was available for runtime tests.

## Remaining blockers

- **GPU / 3D (hardware)**: kbase UAPI mapped (UK 10.6 / r15p0) and a userspace
  kbase client, Panfrost M0 module/LPAE code, and a T720 DT compatible were
  delivered. The ROM blob is r7p0 and wire-incompatible with r15p0; no Mesa
  kbase backend exists. Hardware 3D needs ARM's r15p0 Linux DDK (closed,
  absent) or a Panfrost port (80-125 person-days kernel-only). Software GL is
  installed by the device package (llvmpipe + Xorg fbdev); it is not Mali
  acceleration.
- **Telephony (calls/SMS/data)**: `j7elte-cbd` boots the CP and `j7elte-ril`
  implements SIPC5 transport, IMEI, SIM-lock and network state. Calls/SMS/data
  still need the remaining proprietary RIL message layer.
- **GPS**: power/NMEA forwarding works, but the BCM4752 init exchange is proprietary;
  a hardware capture is required to finish it.
- **Camera**: basic capture + optional AE/AWB metadata loop; JPEG and the full
  3A HAL are not implemented.
- **Display**: the DRM/KMS driver compiles; a hardware modeset is still untested.

## Notes

- The original stock zip remains at `/home/asdf/Downloads/SAMFW.COM_SM-J700M_PCW_J700MUBU2BRC2_fac.zip`.
- 218 scratch entries moved from `/tmp` to `session/tmp-artifacts/` (see `MANIFEST.txt`).
- Verification is static plus cross-build; no runtime test on the phone was possible here.

- `parity/verify.sh`: **22 patches OK, 2 skipped, 0 failed**.

**Why hardware 3D is still blocked**

The RE fan-out confirmed it is a wire-level mismatch, not a missing package:

- Kernel: kbase `/dev/mali0`, UK 10.6 / r15p0; no DRM render node.
- ROM blob: r7p0 / UK 10.0, ELF32 Android bionic. `kbase_uk_job_submit` is 32 B vs 40 B, atom 48/56 vs 64, `core_req` at 34 vs 44 — the kernel rejects the blob's submit ioctl before parsing payload. It can handshake/allocate but cannot submit.

- ARM's Linux Midgard DDK matching r15p0 would bind (32-bit layout also verified), but it is closed, armhf/glibc, absent, and non-redistributable.

So: software 3D is unblocked and installed; hardware acceleration is not reachable with the artifacts on disk. The only routes are the r15p0 Linux DDK blob or completing the Panfrost port.

- Calls/SMS/data: proprietary Samsung SIPC5 RIL message layer; transport/IMEI/SIM/network are implemented.
- GPS: Broadcom SW flow-control step; needs a hardware capture.
- Camera: JPEG and full 3A HAL.
- Display: DRM/KMS driver compiles; hardware modeset untested.
- GPU: r15p0 DDK or full Panfrost port.

tasks.task:
# GPU: kbase legacy r7p0 UAPI compatibility shim

The target is the Nura 3.10 kernel (kbase), not mainline/Panfrost. The ROM's Android blob is r7p0/UK10.0; the kernel is r15p0/UK10.6. Read `parity/reports/gpu-kbase.md` and `parity/userspace/gpu/kbase/analysis.md` for the exact wire mismatches.

## Work
1. Inspect `drivers/gpu/arm/t7xx/r15p0/` dispatch and the legacy header layout: `kbase_uk_job_submit` 32 vs 40 bytes, atom 48/56 vs 64, `core_req` u16@34 vs u32@44, vendor ID shift +4, removed EXT_BUFFER_LOCK. Confirm in source.
2. Add a narrow compatibility path in `kbase_dispatch` (or a translation layer) that recognises the legacy sizes/ids and translates the r7p0 structures to the r15p0 ones. Do not change the native r15p0 path. Reject anything that cannot be translated safely.
3. Build the kernel with the default config (kbase enabled) using `parity/build.sh`; fix compile errors. Do not enable DRM.
4. Export a patch under `parity/patches/gpu-kbase-compat/`, write `parity/reports/gpu-kbase-compat.md` with the translation table, build log, and the exact remaining blocker for running the Android blob (libhybris/32-bit bionic still required). No hardware test; no fake submission success.

Own: `drivers/gpu/arm/t7xx/r15p0/**` and the new patch. Return JSON.

# j7elte ROM <-> Nura driver parity session

Working directory for the Samsung Galaxy J7 (2015) `SM-J700M` (`j7elte`, Exynos 7580)
kernel driver parity work between the stock Android ROM and Nura (formerly postmarketOS).

## Device / sources

- Stock ROM: `SM-J700M` `J700MUBU2BRC2`, Android 6.0.1, kernel `3.10.61-13213628`.
- ROM kernel: raw arm64 `Image`, all drivers built in (no `.ko` modules),
  55,634 kallsyms symbols recovered.
- Nura kernel: `LineageOS/android_kernel_samsung_universal7580` @ `2a746c1`,
  downstream 3.10.108, baseline commit `b5e363a`. Nura is **not** mainline for this device.
- Upstream reference: Linux 7.3 (kernel.org), used only for the parity survey.

## Layout

```
boot.img, recovery.img, system.img, system.raw   extracted ROM images
AP_J700MUBU2BRC2_..._user_low_ship.tar.md5       AP tar (extracted from the stock zip)
boot_out/                                        kernel.bin, vmlinux.elf, symbols.txt, dtbs/
android_kernel_samsung_universal7580-.../         Nura kernel tree (clean baseline)
linux-7.3/, linux-7.3.tar.xz                      upstream reference
toolchains/                                       GCC 10.3 aarch64 toolchain
config-nura-j7elte                                Nura build config (pristine)
lineage-kernel.tar.gz                             Nura kernel source archive
tools/                                            boot image / config comparison helpers
session/tmp-artifacts/                            scratch files moved out of /tmp
parity/                                           all deliverables (see below)
```

`parity/`:

```
patches/          7 exported patches (kernel + pmaports)
reports/          14 per-driver reports (P1-P4 evidence)
firmware/         extracted ROM blobs + per-driver file lists + MANIFEST.sha512
pmaports/         pmaports baseline ba682bd + uncommitted integration changes
build-src/        kernel worktree with build patches + parity kernel patches applied
out/              built Image and rev00/rev04/rev06 DTBs
build.sh          kernel build script (GCC 10.3)
verify.sh         applies every patch with git apply --check against the baselines
contract.md       parity definition and evidence rules
*.log             baseline / camera / final build logs
```

## Patches

Kernel (apply to the baseline kernel tree, commit `b5e363a`):

1. `parity/patches/bluetooth/0001-j7elte-bt-pinctrl.patch`
   - BT enable pin was `gpa1-6`; ROM uses `gpc4-2` on all three board revisions.
2. `parity/patches/camera/0001-fimc-is2-fallback-to-request_firmware-for-fw-version-check.patch`
   - FIMC-IS firmware version check hard-failed on `/system/vendor/firmware`;
     add a `request_firmware()` fallback so `/lib/firmware` works.
3. `parity/patches/drm/0001-drm-exynos7580-decon-dsim-kms.patch`
   - new `drivers/gpu/drm/exynos7580/` KMS driver (DECON + DSIM + ea8061).
4. `parity/patches/drm/0002-arm64-dts-exynos7580-j7elte-drm-display.patch`
   - DT compatibles for the DRM driver on rev00/04/06.

pmaports (apply in this order to `parity/pmaports`, baseline `ba682bd`):

5. `parity/patches/wifi/0001-j7elte-wifi-firmware-paths.patch`
   - `BCMDHD_FW_PATH` / `BCMDHD_NVRAM_PATH` -> `/lib/firmware/postmarketos/samsung-j7elte/`.
6. `parity/patches/bluetooth/0002-j7elte-bt-hci-config.patch`
   - enable `CONFIG_BT_HCIUART` + `CONFIG_BT_HCIUART_H4` for BlueZ.
7. `parity/patches/pmaports/0003-firmware-samsung-j7elte-package.patch`
   - new `firmware-samsung-j7elte` package (Wi-Fi, BT, FIMC-IS, MFC blobs).
8. `parity/patches/pmaports/0005-linux-samsung-j7elte-config-sha512.patch`
   - updated config checksum after the two config changes.
9. `parity/patches/userspace/0001-device-deps.patch`
   - `device-samsung-j7elte` depends on the firmware and all userspace packages.
10. `parity/patches/userspace/audio/0002-j7elte-audio-ucm-package.patch`
11. `parity/patches/userspace/connectivity/0001-j7elte-wifi-package.patch`
12. `parity/patches/userspace/connectivity/0002-j7elte-bt-package.patch`
13. `parity/patches/userspace/sensors/0001-add-j7elte-sensors-package.patch`
14. `parity/patches/userspace/battery/0001-pmaports-add-j7elte-power-package.patch`
15. `parity/patches/userspace/gps/0001-pmaports-add-j7elte-gpsd-package.patch`
16. `parity/patches/userspace/ril/0001-j7elte-cbd-package.patch`
17. `parity/patches/userspace/camera/0001-pmaports-add-j7elte-cam-package.patch`
18. `parity/patches/userspace/fde/0001-j7elte-fde-package.patch`
19. `parity/patches/userspace/gpu/0001-j7elte-gpu-soft-package.patch`
   - software GL (Mesa llvmpipe + Xorg fbdev); pulled in by the device package.
20. `parity/patches/userspace/audio/0003-j7elte-audio-jack-package.patch`
21. `parity/patches/userspace/ril/0002-j7elte-ril-package.patch`

Dependent/optional patches:
- `parity/patches/userspace/review-a/0001-j7elte-sensors-ignore-unknown-dbus-header-fields.patch`
  (apply after `sensors/0001`; required for GDBus clients)
- `parity/patches/userspace/gpu-panfrost/0001-arm64-dts-exynos7580-add-mali-t720-compatible.patch`
  (optional kernel DT string for a future Panfrost driver; kbase still binds)

The GPS daemon source is also exported as
`parity/patches/userspace/gps/0002-userspace-add-j7elte-gpsd-source.patch`
(source tree; `verify.sh` skips it because it targets `parity/userspace/`).

DRM config fragment (opt-in, used for the final build):
`parity/patches/drm/config-drm-exynos7580.fragment`.

Verify everything:

```
cd parity
./verify.sh          # 22 patches OK; 2 skipped (source-tree + dependent fix)
```

## Build

Base build (vendor fbdev display, camera + BT patches):

```
./parity/build.sh parity/build-src parity/out Image dtbs
```

Result: `BUILD_EXIT=0`, Image 17,365,040 B, three j7elte DTBs under `parity/out/`.

Final combined build (adds the DRM/KMS driver; opt-in config):

```
CFG=parity/final-config ./parity/build.sh parity/final-kernel-check parity/final-out Image dtbs
```

- `parity/final-kernel-check` is a clean `b5e363a` worktree with the pmaports
  build patches (GCC 10, fix-argb, sun/Solaris flag, etc.) plus the Bluetooth,
  camera and DRM kernel patches.
- `parity/final-config` is the WiFi/BT kernel config plus
  `parity/patches/drm/config-drm-exynos7580.fragment` (DRM, 32 MB CMA, vendor
  fbdev display path disabled).
- Result: `BUILD_EXIT=0`, Image **17,545,608 B**, three j7elte DTBs under
  `parity/final-out/`, `exynos7580_{drm,decon,dsim}.o` built, camera fallback
  and BT `gpc4-2` group present in the outputs.

Keep the vendor fbdev path as the fallback; do not enable both display stacks
at once.

## Firmware package

`parity/pmaports/device/archived/firmware-samsung-j7elte/` contains:

- `APKBUILD` (deterministic `firmware.tar.gz`, sha512 pinned)
- `extract-firmware.sh` (rebuilds the tarball from the stock AP tar; verifies `files.sha512`)
- `files.sha512` (per-blob checksums)

Install destinations:

- `/lib/firmware/postmarketos/samsung-j7elte/` - bcmdhd firmware/NVRAM, BT HCD
- `/lib/firmware/` - `fimc_is_fw2_3l2.bin`, `setfile_3l2.bin`, `setfile_5e3.bin`,
  `fimc_is_fd.bin`, `mfc_fw.bin`

## Kernel driver parity (first round)

- 11 driver families at parity: display, battery, audio, sensors, storage, touch,
  USB, GPS, GPU, platform (thermal/devfreq/IOMMU/cpufreq), modem.
- 3 driver families patched: Wi-Fi (config), Bluetooth (DT + config), camera (driver fallback).
- The ROM's driver set is already present in the Nura fork; no driver code was missing
  for those families.

## New DRM/KMS driver (display)

- `parity/patches/drm/0001-drm-exynos7580-decon-dsim-kms.patch`
  adds `drivers/gpu/drm/exynos7580/` (DECON CRTC/plane, DSIM encoder/connector,
  ea8061 panel init, dumb buffers + fbdev).
- `parity/patches/drm/0002-arm64-dts-exynos7580-j7elte-drm-display.patch`
  adds `samsung,exynos7580-decon-drm` / `samsung,exynos7580-dsim` to rev00/04/06.
- `parity/patches/drm/config-drm-exynos7580.fragment` enables DRM,
  `CONFIG_DRM_EXYNOS7580`, 32 MB CMA, and disables the vendor fbdev display path.
- Verified build: `parity/final-out/arch/arm64/boot/Image` (17,545,608 B) + three
  j7elte DTBs; `exynos7580_{drm,decon,dsim}.o` are built and the DTBs contain the
  new compatibles.
- Hardware-untested. Keep the vendor fbdev driver as the fallback until a real
  modeset is validated on the phone.

## Userspace gap packages

New pmaports packages, all pulled in by `device-samsung-j7elte` depends:

| Package | Gap | Status |
|---|---|---|
| `j7elte-audio-ucm` | UCM2 routing/mixer for COD3022X (54/54 controls validated) | implemented |
| `j7elte-audio-jack` | `sec_jack` uevent -> UCM2 speaker/headphone/headset-mic routing | implemented |
| `j7elte-wifi` | wpa_supplicant template, `/efs/wifi` MAC provisioning | implemented |
| `j7elte-bt` | rfkill + hciattach + bluetoothd service, BCM43438A1.hcd | implemented |
| `j7elte-sensors` | K2HH/CM36672P/STK3013 to `net.hadess.SensorProxy`; D-Bus UNIX_FDS fix | implemented |
| `j7elte-power` | power_supply/UPower integration, capacity_max restore | implemented |
| `j7elte-fde` | unl0kr/fbdev initramfs integration for FDE | implemented |
| `j7elte-gpu-soft` | Mesa llvmpipe + Xorg fbdev software GL (installed by device package) | implemented (software only) |
| `j7elte-gpsd` | BCM4752 power + NMEA forwarder + first BRI handshake frames | partial: SW flow-control step unresolved |
| `j7elte-cam` | V4L2 capture + optional AE/AWB metadata loop | implemented (basic capture + AE; no JPEG/3A HAL) |
| `j7elte-cbd` | CP boot loader for `/dev/umts_boot0` | partial: RIL layer blocked |
| `j7elte-ril` | SIPC5 transport, IMEI, SIM lock, network state | partial: calls/SMS/data not implemented |
| `firmware-samsung-j7elte` | Wi-Fi/BT/FIMC-IS/MFC blobs | implemented |

Details and test plans are in `parity/reports/*-userspace.md`.

## Second-round verification

- 18 pmaports patches (firmware, kernel config, all userspace packages, RIL,
  audio jack, the dependent sensor D-Bus fix, and device deps) apply cleanly in
  order to a fresh `ba682bd` worktree.
- Combined kernel build with camera + Bluetooth + DRM patches and the DRM config
  fragment: `BUILD_EXIT=0`, `Image` 17,545,608 B, three DTBs.
- The built Image contains the camera `request_firmware` fallback and the

Working directory for the Samsung Galaxy J7 (2015) `SM-J700M` (`j7elte`, Exynos 7580)
kernel driver parity work between the stock Android ROM and Nura (formerly postmarketOS).

## Device / sources

- Stock ROM: `SM-J700M` `J700MUBU2BRC2`, Android 6.0.1, kernel `3.10.61-13213628`.
- ROM kernel: raw arm64 `Image`, all drivers built in (no `.ko` modules),
  55,634 kallsyms symbols recovered.
- Nura kernel: `LineageOS/android_kernel_samsung_universal7580` @ `2a746c1`,
  downstream 3.10.108, baseline commit `b5e363a`. Nura is **not** mainline for this device.
- Upstream reference: Linux 7.3 (kernel.org), used only for the parity survey.

## Layout

```
boot.img, recovery.img, system.img, system.raw   extracted ROM images
AP_J700MUBU2BRC2_..._user_low_ship.tar.md5       AP tar (extracted from the stock zip)
boot_out/                                        kernel.bin, vmlinux.elf, symbols.txt, dtbs/
android_kernel_samsung_universal7580-.../         Nura kernel tree (clean baseline)
linux-7.3/, linux-7.3.tar.xz                      upstream reference
toolchains/                                       GCC 10.3 aarch64 toolchain
config-nura-j7elte                                Nura build config (pristine)
lineage-kernel.tar.gz                             Nura kernel source archive
tools/                                            boot image / config comparison helpers
session/tmp-artifacts/                            scratch files moved out of /tmp
parity/                                           all deliverables (see below)
```

`parity/`:

```
patches/          7 exported patches (kernel + pmaports)
reports/          14 per-driver reports (P1-P4 evidence)
firmware/         extracted ROM blobs + per-driver file lists + MANIFEST.sha512
pmaports/         pmaports baseline ba682bd + uncommitted integration changes
build-src/        kernel worktree with build patches + parity kernel patches applied
out/              built Image and rev00/rev04/rev06 DTBs

# RE inventory: libGLES_mali.so (r7p0)

Read `parity/reports/gpu-userspace.md`, `parity/reports/gpu-kbase.md`, and `parity/userspace/gpu/kbase/analysis.md`.

## Scope (inventory/analysis; no full reimplementation)
1. Extract `/vendor/lib/egl/libGLES_mali.so` (23.4 MB, ELF32 ARM EABI5, stripped) and the Android libs it needs from `system.raw`. Record hashes/versions.
2. Map the exported/dynamic symbols and the internal function groups: EGL/GLES entry points, the kbase ioctl client (`/dev/mali0` calls), the Midgard shader compiler, the command-stream/batch builder, and the Android WSI/gralloc/binder dependencies. Use Ghidra headless (ARM:LE:32:v7) and objdump; cite addresses.
3. Estimate what is reusable vs what must be rewritten for an open Linux driver. Compare with Mesa's existing Panfrost Midgard compiler/command stream (open source) and identify the actual missing layer (kbase winsys/UK10.6 backend, WSI).
4. Write `parity/userspace/gpu/blob/map.md` and `parity/reports/mali-blob-re.md`. No code, no claims of a working driver.

Return JSON.

# Mesa on kbase: first open backend milestone

The Nura kernel exposes kbase UK10.6/r15p0 (`/dev/mali0`), not DRM. Mesa's Panfrost Gallium driver already has an open Midgard compiler/command stream for T720, but its winsys is DRM-based. Deliver the first real, buildable milestone of a **kbase winsys** for Mesa (not a fake renderer).

## Work
1. Clone Mesa shallow into `parity/userspace/gpu/mesa/` (or use an existing checkout) and inspect `src/gallium/drivers/panfrost` + `src/panfrost` winsys/drm interfaces. Identify the exact winsys/KMD hooks (buffer alloc/mmap, submit, fence, screen/context, WSI).
2. Use `parity/userspace/gpu/kbase/` (UAPI mapping, kbase.c) as the kbase client. Implement a standalone `kbase_winsys` library first (device open, UK version/flags handshake, mem alloc/mmap, at least one soft-job/event round-trip) and a Gallium screen/context skeleton that links against Mesa but does not fake rendering.
3. Build what you can (host/aarch64 as appropriate). If a full Mesa driver is out of reach, deliver the winsys library + a precise integration plan and blockers; do not claim GL works.
4. Export code/patch under `parity/patches/gpu-mesa-kbase/`, report `parity/reports/gpu-mesa-kbase.md` with build result, integration points, and the remaining userspace/WSI work.

Own: `parity/userspace/gpu/mesa/`, `parity/userspace/gpu/kbase-winsys/`, `parity/patches/gpu-mesa-kbase/`. No kernel edits (kbase-compat is another agent). Return JSON.

# j7elte ROM <-> Nura driver parity session

Working directory for the Samsung Galaxy J7 (2015) `SM-J700M` (`j7elte`, Exynos 7580)
kernel driver parity work between the stock Android ROM and Nura (formerly postmarketOS).

## Device / sources

- Stock ROM: `SM-J700M` `J700MUBU2BRC2`, Android 6.0.1, kernel `3.10.61-13213628`.
- ROM kernel: raw arm64 `Image`, all drivers built in (no `.ko` modules),
  55,634 kallsyms symbols recovered.
- Nura kernel: `LineageOS/android_kernel_samsung_universal7580` @ `2a746c1`,
  downstream 3.10.108, baseline commit `b5e363a`. Nura is **not** mainline for this device.
- Upstream reference: Linux 7.3 (kernel.org), used only for the parity survey.

## Layout

```
boot.img, recovery.img, system.img, system.raw   extracted ROM images
AP_J700MUBU2BRC2_..._user_low_ship.tar.md5       AP tar (extracted from the stock zip)
boot_out/                                        kernel.bin, vmlinux.elf, symbols.txt, dtbs/
android_kernel_samsung_universal7580-.../         Nura kernel tree (clean baseline)
linux-7.3/, linux-7.3.tar.xz                      upstream reference
toolchains/                                       GCC 10.3 aarch64 toolchain
config-nura-j7elte                                Nura build config (pristine)
lineage-kernel.tar.gz                             Nura kernel source archive
tools/                                            boot image / config comparison helpers
session/tmp-artifacts/                            scratch files moved out of /tmp
parity/                                           all deliverables (see below)
```

`parity/`:

```
patches/          7 exported patches (kernel + pmaports)
reports/          14 per-driver reports (P1-P4 evidence)
firmware/         extracted ROM blobs + per-driver file lists + MANIFEST.sha512
pmaports/         pmaports baseline ba682bd + uncommitted integration changes
build-src/        kernel worktree with build patches + parity kernel patches applied
out/              built Image and rev00/rev04/rev06 DTBs
build.sh          kernel build script (GCC 10.3)
verify.sh         applies every patch with git apply --check against the baselines
contract.md       parity definition and evidence rules
*.log             baseline / camera / final build logs
```

## Patches

Kernel (apply to the baseline kernel tree, commit `b5e363a`):

1. `parity/patches/bluetooth/0001-j7elte-bt-pinctrl.patch`
   - BT enable pin was `gpa1-6`; ROM uses `gpc4-2` on all three board revisions.
2. `parity/patches/camera/0001-fimc-is2-fallback-to-request_firmware-for-fw-version-check.patch`
   - FIMC-IS firmware version check hard-failed on `/system/vendor/firmware`;
     add a `request_firmware()` fallback so `/lib/firmware` works.
3. `parity/patches/drm/0001-drm-exynos7580-decon-dsim-kms.patch`
   - new `drivers/gpu/drm/exynos7580/` KMS driver (DECON + DSIM + ea8061).
4. `parity/patches/drm/0002-arm64-dts-exynos7580-j7elte-drm-display.patch`
   - DT compatibles for the DRM driver on rev00/04/06.

pmaports (apply in this order to `parity/pmaports`, baseline `ba682bd`):

5. `parity/patches/wifi/0001-j7elte-wifi-firmware-paths.patch`
   - `BCMDHD_FW_PATH` / `BCMDHD_NVRAM_PATH` -> `/lib/firmware/postmarketos/samsung-j7elte/`.
6. `parity/patches/bluetooth/0002-j7elte-bt-hci-config.patch`
   - enable `CONFIG_BT_HCIUART` + `CONFIG_BT_HCIUART_H4` for BlueZ.
7. `parity/patches/pmaports/0003-firmware-samsung-j7elte-package.patch`
   - new `firmware-samsung-j7elte` package (Wi-Fi, BT, FIMC-IS, MFC blobs).
8. `parity/patches/pmaports/0005-linux-samsung-j7elte-config-sha512.patch`
   - updated config checksum after the two config changes.
9. `parity/patches/userspace/0001-device-deps.patch`
   - `device-samsung-j7elte` depends on the firmware and all userspace packages.
10. `parity/patches/userspace/audio/0002-j7elte-audio-ucm-package.patch`
11. `parity/patches/userspace/connectivity/0001-j7elte-wifi-package.patch`
12. `parity/patches/userspace/connectivity/0002-j7elte-bt-package.patch`
13. `parity/patches/userspace/sensors/0001-add-j7elte-sensors-package.patch`
14. `parity/patches/userspace/battery/0001-pmaports-add-j7elte-power-package.patch`
15. `parity/patches/userspace/gps/0001-pmaports-add-j7elte-gpsd-package.patch`
16. `parity/patches/userspace/ril/0001-j7elte-cbd-package.patch`
17. `parity/patches/userspace/camera/0001-pmaports-add-j7elte-cam-package.patch`
18. `parity/patches/userspace/fde/0001-j7elte-fde-package.patch`
19. `parity/patches/userspace/gpu/0001-j7elte-gpu-soft-package.patch`
   - software GL (Mesa llvmpipe + Xorg fbdev); pulled in by the device package.
20. `parity/patches/userspace/audio/0003-j7elte-audio-jack-package.patch`
21. `parity/patches/userspace/ril/0002-j7elte-ril-package.patch`

Dependent/optional patches:
- `parity/patches/userspace/review-a/0001-j7elte-sensors-ignore-unknown-dbus-header-fields.patch`
  (apply after `sensors/0001`; required for GDBus clients)
- `parity/patches/userspace/gpu-panfrost/0001-arm64-dts-exynos7580-add-mali-t720-compatible.patch`
  (optional kernel DT string for a future Panfrost driver; kbase still binds)

The GPS daemon source is also exported as
`parity/patches/userspace/gps/0002-userspace-add-j7elte-gpsd-source.patch`
(source tree; `verify.sh` skips it because it targets `parity/userspace/`).

DRM config fragment (opt-in, used for the final build):
`parity/patches/drm/config-drm-exynos7580.fragment`.

Verify everything:

```
cd parity
./verify.sh          # 22 patches OK; 2 skipped (source-tree + dependent fix)
```

## Build

Base build (vendor fbdev display, camera + BT patches):

```
./parity/build.sh parity/build-src parity/out Image dtbs
```

Result: `BUILD_EXIT=0`, Image 17,365,040 B, three j7elte DTBs under `parity/out/`.

Final combined build (adds the DRM/KMS driver; opt-in config):

```
CFG=parity/final-config ./parity/build.sh parity/final-kernel-check parity/final-out Image dtbs
```

- `parity/final-kernel-check` is a clean `b5e363a` worktree with the pmaports
  build patches (GCC 10, fix-argb, sun/Solaris flag, etc.) plus the Bluetooth,
  camera and DRM kernel patches.
- `parity/final-config` is the WiFi/BT kernel config plus
  `parity/patches/drm/config-drm-exynos7580.fragment` (DRM, 32 MB CMA, vendor
  fbdev display path disabled).
- Result: `BUILD_EXIT=0`, Image **17,545,608 B**, three j7elte DTBs under
  `parity/final-out/`, `exynos7580_{drm,decon,dsim}.o` built, camera fallback
  and BT `gpc4-2` group present in the outputs.

Keep the vendor fbdev path as the fallback; do not enable both display stacks
at once.

## Firmware package

`parity/pmaports/device/archived/firmware-samsung-j7elte/` contains:

- `APKBUILD` (deterministic `firmware.tar.gz`, sha512 pinned)
- `extract-firmware.sh` (rebuilds the tarball from the stock AP tar; verifies `files.sha512`)
- `files.sha512` (per-blob checksums)

Install destinations:

- `/lib/firmware/postmarketos/samsung-j7elte/` - bcmdhd firmware/NVRAM, BT HCD
- `/lib/firmware/` - `fimc_is_fw2_3l2.bin`, `setfile_3l2.bin`, `setfile_5e3.bin`,
  `fimc_is_fd.bin`, `mfc_fw.bin`

## Kernel driver parity (first round)

- 11 driver families at parity: display, battery, audio, sensors, storage, touch,
  USB, GPS, GPU, platform (thermal/devfreq/IOMMU/cpufreq), modem.
- 3 driver families patched: Wi-Fi (config), Bluetooth (DT + config), camera (driver fallback).
- The ROM's driver set is already present in the Nura fork; no driver code was missing
  for those families.

## New DRM/KMS driver (display)

- `parity/patches/drm/0001-drm-exynos7580-decon-dsim-kms.patch`
  adds `drivers/gpu/drm/exynos7580/` (DECON CRTC/plane, DSIM encoder/connector,
  ea8061 panel init, dumb buffers + fbdev).
- `parity/patches/drm/0002-arm64-dts-exynos7580-j7elte-drm-display.patch`
  adds `samsung,exynos7580-decon-drm` / `samsung,exynos7580-dsim` to rev00/04/06.
- `parity/patches/drm/config-drm-exynos7580.fragment` enables DRM,
  `CONFIG_DRM_EXYNOS7580`, 32 MB CMA, and disables the vendor fbdev display path.
- Verified build: `parity/final-out/arch/arm64/boot/Image` (17,545,608 B) + three
  j7elte DTBs; `exynos7580_{drm,decon,dsim}.o` are built and the DTBs contain the
  new compatibles.
- Hardware-untested. Keep the vendor fbdev driver as the fallback until a real
  modeset is validated on the phone.

## Userspace gap packages

New pmaports packages, all pulled in by `device-samsung-j7elte` depends:

| Package | Gap | Status |
|---|---|---|
| `j7elte-audio-ucm` | UCM2 routing/mixer for COD3022X (54/54 controls validated) | implemented |
| `j7elte-audio-jack` | `sec_jack` uevent -> UCM2 speaker/headphone/headset-mic routing | implemented |
| `j7elte-wifi` | wpa_supplicant template, `/efs/wifi` MAC provisioning | implemented |
| `j7elte-bt` | rfkill + hciattach + bluetoothd service, BCM43438A1.hcd | implemented |
| `j7elte-sensors` | K2HH/CM36672P/STK3013 to `net.hadess.SensorProxy`; D-Bus UNIX_FDS fix | implemented |
| `j7elte-power` | power_supply/UPower integration, capacity_max restore | implemented |
| `j7elte-fde` | unl0kr/fbdev initramfs integration for FDE | implemented |
| `j7elte-gpu-soft` | Mesa llvmpipe + Xorg fbdev software GL (installed by device package) | implemented (software only) |
| `j7elte-gpsd` | BCM4752 power + NMEA forwarder + first BRI handshake frames | partial: SW flow-control step unresolved |
| `j7elte-cam` | V4L2 capture + optional AE/AWB metadata loop | implemented (basic capture + AE; no JPEG/3A HAL) |
| `j7elte-cbd` | CP boot loader for `/dev/umts_boot0` | partial: RIL layer blocked |
| `j7elte-ril` | SIPC5 transport, IMEI, SIM lock, network state | partial: calls/SMS/data not implemented |
| `firmware-samsung-j7elte` | Wi-Fi/BT/FIMC-IS/MFC blobs | implemented |

Details and test plans are in `parity/reports/*-userspace.md`.

## Second-round verification

- 18 pmaports patches (firmware, kernel config, all userspace packages, RIL,
  audio jack, the dependent sensor D-Bus fix, and device deps) apply cleanly in
  order to a fresh `ba682bd` worktree.
- Combined kernel build with camera + Bluetooth + DRM patches and the DRM config
  fragment: `BUILD_EXIT=0`, `Image` 17,545,608 B, three DTBs.
- The built Image contains the camera `request_firmware` fallback and the
  `samsung,exynos7580-decon-drm` compatible; the built DTB routes `bluetooth`
  pinctrl to `gpc4-2` and contains the DRM display compatibles.
- Verification is static plus cross-build; no phone was available for runtime tests.

## Remaining blockers

- **GPU / 3D (hardware)**: the target is the Nura 3.10 **kbase** kernel, not
  mainline. Panfrost is therefore not the Nura path: it requires mainline DRM
  (absent in 3.10) and mainline has no Exynos7580 support. The Panfrost M0/LPAE
  work is a feasibility artifact only. The Nura paths are:
  1. ARM r15p0/UK10.6 Linux DDK userspace (closed, absent, non-redistributable);
  2. a kbase r7p0 compatibility shim so the existing Android r7p0 blob can
     submit on the r15p0 kernel (in progress), plus a 32-bit bionic/libhybris
     userspace layer;
  3. a new Mesa kbase backend for UK10.6 (large userspace project).
  Software GL is installed by the device package (llvmpipe + Xorg fbdev); it is
  not Mali acceleration.
- **Telephony (calls/SMS/data)**: `j7elte-cbd` boots the CP and `j7elte-ril`
  implements SIPC5 transport, IMEI, SIM-lock and network state. Calls/SMS/data
  still need the remaining proprietary RIL message layer.
- **GPS**: power/NMEA forwarding and the first BRI handshake frames (autobaud,
  `Bri_GetOutOfLegacy`, `Bri_RequestHwVersion`, `Bri_RequestDebugSfr`) are
  implemented byte-exact from the ROM binary; the sequence stops at Broadcom's
  SW flow-control search, which needs a hardware UART capture.
- **Camera**: basic capture + optional AE/AWB metadata loop; JPEG and the full
  3A HAL are not implemented.
- **Display**: the DRM/KMS driver compiles; a hardware modeset is still untested.

## Notes

- The original stock zip remains at `/home/asdf/Downloads/SAMFW.COM_SM-J700M_PCW_J700MUBU2BRC2_fac.zip`.
- 218 scratch entries moved from `/tmp` to `session/tmp-artifacts/` (see `MANIFEST.txt`).
- Verification is static plus cross-build; no runtime test on the phone was possible here.

## Kernel driver parity (first round)

- 11 driver families at parity: display, battery, audio, sensors, storage, touch,
  USB, GPS, GPU, platform (thermal/devfreq/IOMMU/cpufreq), modem.
- 3 driver families patched: Wi-Fi (config), Bluetooth (DT + config), camera (driver fallback).

  for those families.

## New DRM/KMS driver (display)

- `parity/patches/drm/0001-drm-exynos7580-decon-dsim-kms.patch`
  adds `drivers/gpu/drm/exynos7580/` (DECON CRTC/plane, DSIM encoder/connector,
  ea8061 panel init, dumb buffers + fbdev).

  adds `samsung,exynos7580-decon-drm` / `samsung,exynos7580-dsim` to rev00/04/06.

  modeset is validated on the phone.

## Userspace gap packages

New pmaports packages, all pulled in by `device-samsung-j7elte` depends:

| Package | Gap | Status |
|---|---|---|
| `j7elte-audio-ucm` | UCM2 routing/mixer for COD3022X (54/54 controls validated) | implemented |
| `j7elte-audio-jack` | `sec_jack` uevent -> UCM2 speaker/headphone/headset-mic routing | implemented |
| `j7elte-wifi` | wpa_supplicant template, `/efs/wifi` MAC provisioning | implemented |
| `j7elte-bt` | rfkill + hciattach + bluetoothd service, BCM43438A1.hcd | implemented |
| `j7elte-sensors` | K2HH/CM36672P/STK3013 to `net.hadess.SensorProxy`; D-Bus UNIX_FDS fix | implemented |
| `j7elte-power` | power_supply/UPower integration, capacity_max restore | implemented |
| `j7elte-fde` | unl0kr/fbdev initramfs integration for FDE | implemented |
| `j7elte-gpu-soft` | Mesa llvmpipe + Xorg fbdev software GL (installed by device package) | implemented (software only) |
| `j7elte-gpsd` | BCM4752 power + NMEA forwarder + first BRI handshake frames | partial: SW flow-control step unresolved |
| `j7elte-cam` | V4L2 capture + optional AE/AWB metadata loop | implemented (basic capture + AE; no JPEG/3A HAL) |
| `j7elte-cbd` | CP boot loader for `/dev/umts_boot0` | partial: RIL layer blocked |
| `j7elte-ril` | SIPC5 transport, IMEI, SIM lock, network state | partial: calls/SMS/data not implemented |
| `firmware-samsung-j7elte` | Wi-Fi/BT/FIMC-IS/MFC blobs | implemented |

Details and test plans are in `parity/reports/*-userspace.md`.

## Second-round verification

- 18 pmaports patches (firmware, kernel config, all userspace packages, RIL,
  audio jack, the dependent sensor D-Bus fix, and device deps) apply cleanly in
  order to a fresh `ba682bd` worktree.
- Combined kernel build with camera + Bluetooth + DRM patches and the DRM config
  fragment: `BUILD_EXIT=0`, `Image` 17,545,608 B, three DTBs.
- The built Image contains the camera `request_firmware` fallback and the
  `samsung,exynos7580-decon-drm` compatible; the built DTB routes `bluetooth`
  pinctrl to `gpc4-2` and contains the DRM display compatibles.
- Verification is static plus cross-build; no phone was available for runtime tests.

## Remaining blockers

- **GPU / 3D (hardware)**: the target is the Nura 3.10 **kbase** kernel, not
  mainline. Panfrost is therefore not the Nura path: it requires mainline DRM
  (absent in 3.10) and mainline has no Exynos7580 support. The Panfrost M0/LPAE
  work is a feasibility artifact only. The Nura paths are:
  1. ARM r15p0/UK10.6 Linux DDK userspace (closed, absent, non-redistributable);
  2. a kbase r7p0 compatibility shim so the existing Android r7p0 blob can
     submit on the r15p0 kernel (in progress), plus a 32-bit bionic/libhybris
     userspace layer;
  3. a new Mesa kbase backend for UK10.6 (large userspace project). Mesa already
     has an open Midgard compiler/command stream; the missing layer is the
     kbase winsys/WSI. A blob decompilation inventory is running in parallel.
  Software GL is installed by the device package (llvmpipe + Xorg fbdev); it is
  not Mali acceleration.
- **Telephony (calls/SMS/data)**: `j7elte-cbd` boots the CP and `j7elte-ril`
  implements SIPC5 transport, IMEI, SIM-lock and network state. Calls/SMS/data
  still need the remaining proprietary RIL message layer.
- **GPS**: power/NMEA forwarding and the first BRI handshake frames (autobaud,
  `Bri_GetOutOfLegacy`, `Bri_RequestHwVersion`, `Bri_RequestDebugSfr`) are
  implemented byte-exact from the ROM binary; the sequence stops at Broadcom's
  SW flow-control search, which needs a hardware UART capture.
- **Camera**: basic capture + optional AE/AWB metadata loop; JPEG and the full
  3A HAL are not implemented.
- **Display**: the DRM/KMS driver compiles; a hardware modeset is still untested.

## Notes

- The original stock zip remains at `/home/asdf/Downloads/SAMFW.COM_SM-J700M_PCW_J700MUBU2BRC2_fac.zip`.
- 218 scratch entries moved from `/tmp` to `session/tmp-artifacts/` (see `MANIFEST.txt`).
- Verification is static plus cross-build; no runtime test on the phone was possible here.

  55,634 kallsyms symbols recovered.

- Verification is static plus cross-build; no phone was available for runtime tests.

## Remaining blockers

- **GPU / 3D (hardware)**: the target is the Nura 3.10 **kbase** kernel, not
  mainline. Panfrost is therefore not the Nura path: it requires mainline DRM
  (absent in 3.10) and mainline has no Exynos7580 support. The Panfrost M0/LPAE
  work is a feasibility artifact only. The Nura paths are:
  1. ARM r15p0/UK10.6 Linux DDK userspace (closed, absent, non-redistributable);
  2. a kbase r7p0 compatibility shim so the existing Android r7p0 blob can
     submit on the r15p0 kernel (in progress), plus a 32-bit bionic/libhybris
     userspace layer;
  3. a new Mesa kbase backend for UK10.6 (large userspace project). Mesa already
     has an open Midgard compiler/command stream; the missing layer is the
     kbase winsys/WSI. A blob decompilation inventory is running in parallel.
  Software GL is installed by the device package (llvmpipe + Xorg fbdev); it is
  not Mali acceleration.
- **Telephony (calls/SMS/data)**: `j7elte-cbd` boots the CP and `j7elte-ril`
  implements SIPC5 transport, IMEI, SIM-lock and network state. The SIPC5
  link/FMT framing and transport codec are now reverse-engineered in
  `parity/userspace/ril/sipc5/`; call/SMS/data message slices are in progress.
  Calls/SMS/data still need the remaining proprietary RIL message layer.
- **GPS**: power/NMEA forwarding and the first BRI handshake frames (autobaud,
  `Bri_GetOutOfLegacy`, `Bri_RequestHwVersion`, `Bri_RequestDebugSfr`) are
…
  SW flow-control search, which needs a hardware UART capture.

# j7elte ROM <-> Nura driver parity session

Working directory for the Samsung Galaxy J7 (2015) `SM-J700M` (`j7elte`, Exynos 7580)
kernel driver parity work between the stock Android ROM and Nura (formerly postmarketOS).

## Device / sources

- Stock ROM: `SM-J700M` `J700MUBU2BRC2`, Android 6.0.1, kernel `3.10.61-13213628`.
- ROM kernel: raw arm64 `Image`, all drivers built in (no `.ko` modules),
  55,634 kallsyms symbols recovered.
- Nura kernel: `LineageOS/android_kernel_samsung_universal7580` @ `2a746c1`,
  downstream 3.10.108, baseline commit `b5e363a`. Nura is **not** mainline for this device.
- Upstream reference: Linux 7.3 (kernel.org), used only for the parity survey.

## Layout

```
boot.img, recovery.img, system.img, system.raw   extracted ROM images
AP_J700MUBU2BRC2_..._user_low_ship.tar.md5       AP tar (extracted from the stock zip)
boot_out/                                        kernel.bin, vmlinux.elf, symbols.txt, dtbs/
android_kernel_samsung_universal7580-.../         Nura kernel tree (clean baseline)
linux-7.3/, linux-7.3.tar.xz                      upstream reference
toolchains/                                       GCC 10.3 aarch64 toolchain
config-nura-j7elte                                Nura build config (pristine)
lineage-kernel.tar.gz                             Nura kernel source archive
tools/                                            boot image / config comparison helpers
session/tmp-artifacts/                            scratch files moved out of /tmp
parity/                                           all deliverables (see below)
```

`parity/`:

```
patches/          7 exported patches (kernel + pmaports)
reports/          14 per-driver reports (P1-P4 evidence)
firmware/         extracted ROM blobs + per-driver file lists + MANIFEST.sha512
pmaports/         pmaports baseline ba682bd + uncommitted integration changes
build-src/        kernel worktree with build patches + parity kernel patches applied
out/              built Image and rev00/rev04/rev06 DTBs
build.sh          kernel build script (GCC 10.3)
verify.sh         applies every patch with git apply --check against the baselines
contract.md       parity definition and evidence rules
*.log             baseline / camera / final build logs
```

## Patches

Kernel (apply to the baseline kernel tree, commit `b5e363a`):

1. `parity/patches/bluetooth/0001-j7elte-bt-pinctrl.patch`
   - BT enable pin was `gpa1-6`; ROM uses `gpc4-2` on all three board revisions.
2. `parity/patches/camera/0001-fimc-is2-fallback-to-request_firmware-for-fw-version-check.patch`
   - FIMC-IS firmware version check hard-failed on `/system/vendor/firmware`;
     add a `request_firmware()` fallback so `/lib/firmware` works.
3. `parity/patches/drm/0001-drm-exynos7580-decon-dsim-kms.patch`
   - new `drivers/gpu/drm/exynos7580/` KMS driver (DECON + DSIM + ea8061).
4. `parity/patches/drm/0002-arm64-dts-exynos7580-j7elte-drm-display.patch`
   - DT compatibles for the DRM driver on rev00/04/06.

pmaports (apply in this order to `parity/pmaports`, baseline `ba682bd`):

5. `parity/patches/wifi/0001-j7elte-wifi-firmware-paths.patch`
   - `BCMDHD_FW_PATH` / `BCMDHD_NVRAM_PATH` -> `/lib/firmware/postmarketos/samsung-j7elte/`.
6. `parity/patches/bluetooth/0002-j7elte-bt-hci-config.patch`
   - enable `CONFIG_BT_HCIUART` + `CONFIG_BT_HCIUART_H4` for BlueZ.
7. `parity/patches/pmaports/0003-firmware-samsung-j7elte-package.patch`
   - new `firmware-samsung-j7elte` package (Wi-Fi, BT, FIMC-IS, MFC blobs).
8. `parity/patches/pmaports/0005-linux-samsung-j7elte-config-sha512.patch`
   - updated config checksum after the two config changes.
9. `parity/patches/userspace/0001-device-deps.patch`
   - `device-samsung-j7elte` depends on the firmware and all userspace packages.
10. `parity/patches/userspace/audio/0002-j7elte-audio-ucm-package.patch`
11. `parity/patches/userspace/connectivity/0001-j7elte-wifi-package.patch`
12. `parity/patches/userspace/connectivity/0002-j7elte-bt-package.patch`
13. `parity/patches/userspace/sensors/0001-add-j7elte-sensors-package.patch`
14. `parity/patches/userspace/battery/0001-pmaports-add-j7elte-power-package.patch`
15. `parity/patches/userspace/gps/0001-pmaports-add-j7elte-gpsd-package.patch`
16. `parity/patches/userspace/ril/0001-j7elte-cbd-package.patch`
17. `parity/patches/userspace/camera/0001-pmaports-add-j7elte-cam-package.patch`
18. `parity/patches/userspace/fde/0001-j7elte-fde-package.patch`
19. `parity/patches/userspace/gpu/0001-j7elte-gpu-soft-package.patch`
   - software GL (Mesa llvmpipe + Xorg fbdev); pulled in by the device package.
20. `parity/patches/userspace/audio/0003-j7elte-audio-jack-package.patch`
21. `parity/patches/userspace/ril/0002-j7elte-ril-package.patch`

Dependent/optional patches:
- `parity/patches/userspace/review-a/0001-j7elte-sensors-ignore-unknown-dbus-header-fields.patch`
  (apply after `sensors/0001`; required for GDBus clients)
- `parity/patches/userspace/gpu-panfrost/0001-arm64-dts-exynos7580-add-mali-t720-compatible.patch`
  (optional kernel DT string for a future Panfrost driver; kbase still binds)

The GPS daemon source is also exported as
`parity/patches/userspace/gps/0002-userspace-add-j7elte-gpsd-source.patch`
(source tree; `verify.sh` skips it because it targets `parity/userspace/`).

DRM config fragment (opt-in, used for the final build):
`parity/patches/drm/config-drm-exynos7580.fragment`.

Verify everything:

```
cd parity
./verify.sh          # 22 patches OK; 2 skipped (source-tree + dependent fix)
```

## Build

Base build (vendor fbdev display, camera + BT patches):

```
./parity/build.sh parity/build-src parity/out Image dtbs
```

Result: `BUILD_EXIT=0`, Image 17,365,040 B, three j7elte DTBs under `parity/out/`.

Final combined build (adds the DRM/KMS driver; opt-in config):

```
CFG=parity/final-config ./parity/build.sh parity/final-kernel-check parity/final-out Image dtbs
```

- `parity/final-kernel-check` is a clean `b5e363a` worktree with the pmaports
  build patches (GCC 10, fix-argb, sun/Solaris flag, etc.) plus the Bluetooth,
  camera and DRM kernel patches.
- `parity/final-config` is the WiFi/BT kernel config plus
  `parity/patches/drm/config-drm-exynos7580.fragment` (DRM, 32 MB CMA, vendor
  fbdev display path disabled).
- Result: `BUILD_EXIT=0`, Image **17,545,608 B**, three j7elte DTBs under
  `parity/final-out/`, `exynos7580_{drm,decon,dsim}.o` built, camera fallback
  and BT `gpc4-2` group present in the outputs.

Keep the vendor fbdev path as the fallback; do not enable both display stacks
at once.

## Firmware package

`parity/pmaports/device/archived/firmware-samsung-j7elte/` contains:

- `APKBUILD` (deterministic `firmware.tar.gz`, sha512 pinned)
- `extract-firmware.sh` (rebuilds the tarball from the stock AP tar; verifies `files.sha512`)
- `files.sha512` (per-blob checksums)

Install destinations:

- `/lib/firmware/postmarketos/samsung-j7elte/` - bcmdhd firmware/NVRAM, BT HCD
- `/lib/firmware/` - `fimc_is_fw2_3l2.bin`, `setfile_3l2.bin`, `setfile_5e3.bin`,
  `fimc_is_fd.bin`, `mfc_fw.bin`

## Kernel driver parity (first round)

- 11 driver families at parity: display, battery, audio, sensors, storage, touch,
  USB, GPS, GPU, platform (thermal/devfreq/IOMMU/cpufreq), modem.
- 3 driver families patched: Wi-Fi (config), Bluetooth (DT + config), camera (driver fallback).
- The ROM's driver set is already present in the Nura fork; no driver code was missing
  for those families.

## New DRM/KMS driver (display)

- `parity/patches/drm/0001-drm-exynos7580-decon-dsim-kms.patch`
  adds `drivers/gpu/drm/exynos7580/` (DECON CRTC/plane, DSIM encoder/connector,
  ea8061 panel init, dumb buffers + fbdev).
- `parity/patches/drm/0002-arm64-dts-exynos7580-j7elte-drm-display.patch`
  adds `samsung,exynos7580-decon-drm` / `samsung,exynos7580-dsim` to rev00/04/06.
- `parity/patches/drm/config-drm-exynos7580.fragment` enables DRM,
  `CONFIG_DRM_EXYNOS7580`, 32 MB CMA, and disables the vendor fbdev display path.
- Verified build: `parity/final-out/arch/arm64/boot/Image` (17,545,608 B) + three
  j7elte DTBs; `exynos7580_{drm,decon,dsim}.o` are built and the DTBs contain the
  new compatibles.
- Hardware-untested. Keep the vendor fbdev driver as the fallback until a real
  modeset is validated on the phone.

## Userspace gap packages

New pmaports packages, all pulled in by `device-samsung-j7elte` depends:

| Package | Gap | Status |
|---|---|---|
| `j7elte-audio-ucm` | UCM2 routing/mixer for COD3022X (54/54 controls validated) | implemented |
| `j7elte-audio-jack` | `sec_jack` uevent -> UCM2 speaker/headphone/headset-mic routing | implemented |
| `j7elte-wifi` | wpa_supplicant template, `/efs/wifi` MAC provisioning | implemented |
| `j7elte-bt` | rfkill + hciattach + bluetoothd service, BCM43438A1.hcd | implemented |
| `j7elte-sensors` | K2HH/CM36672P/STK3013 to `net.hadess.SensorProxy`; D-Bus UNIX_FDS fix | implemented |
| `j7elte-power` | power_supply/UPower integration, capacity_max restore | implemented |
| `j7elte-fde` | unl0kr/fbdev initramfs integration for FDE | implemented |
| `j7elte-gpu-soft` | Mesa llvmpipe + Xorg fbdev software GL (installed by device package) | implemented (software only) |
| `j7elte-gpsd` | BCM4752 power + NMEA forwarder + first BRI handshake frames | partial: SW flow-control step unresolved |

**Why it is the shorter of the two**

| | Android blob + libhybris | Mesa kbase backend |
|---|---|---|

| ABI | ELF32 Android, r7p0, proprietary | aarch64 native, open |
| Reuse | Android blob only | Mesa’s open Midgard compiler/command stream + the already-mapped kbase UAPI |
