  build patches (GCC 10, fix-argb, sun/Solaris flag, etc.) plus the Bluetooth,
  camera and DRM kernel patches.
- `parity/final-config` is the WiFi/BT kernel config plus
  `parity/patches/drm/config-drm-exynos7580.fragment` (DRM, 32 MB CMA, vendor
  fbdev display path disabled).
- Result: `BUILD_EXIT=0`, Image **17,545,608 B**, three j7elte DTBs under
  `parity/final-out/`, `exynos7580_{drm,decon,dsim}.o` built, camera fallback
  and BT `gpc4-2` group present in the outputs.

Keep the vendor fbdev path as the fallback; do not enable both display stacks
at once.

## Firmware package

`parity/pmaports/device/archived/firmware-samsung-j7elte/` contains:

- `APKBUILD` (deterministic `firmware.tar.gz`, sha512 pinned)
- `extract-firmware.sh` (rebuilds the tarball from the stock AP tar; verifies `files.sha512`)
- `files.sha512` (per-blob checksums)

Install destinations:

- `/lib/firmware/postmarketos/samsung-j7elte/` - bcmdhd firmware/NVRAM, BT HCD
- `/lib/firmware/` - `fimc_is_fw2_3l2.bin`, `setfile_3l2.bin`, `setfile_5e3.bin`,
  `fimc_is_fd.bin`, `mfc_fw.bin`

## Kernel driver parity (first round)

- 11 driver families at parity: display, battery, audio, sensors, storage, touch,
  USB, GPS, GPU, platform (thermal/devfreq/IOMMU/cpufreq), modem.
- 3 driver families patched: Wi-Fi (config), Bluetooth (DT + config), camera (driver fallback).
- The ROM's driver set is already present in the Nura fork; no driver code was missing
  for those families.

## New DRM/KMS driver (display)

- `parity/patches/drm/0001-drm-exynos7580-decon-dsim-kms.patch`
  adds `drivers/gpu/drm/exynos7580/` (DECON CRTC/plane, DSIM encoder/connector,
  ea8061 panel init, dumb buffers + fbdev).
- `parity/patches/drm/0002-arm64-dts-exynos7580-j7elte-drm-display.patch`
  adds `samsung,exynos7580-decon-drm` / `samsung,exynos7580-dsim` to rev00/04/06.
- `parity/patches/drm/config-drm-exynos7580.fragment` enables DRM,
  `CONFIG_DRM_EXYNOS7580`, 32 MB CMA, and disables the vendor fbdev display path.
- Verified build: `parity/final-out/arch/arm64/boot/Image` (17,545,608 B) + three
  j7elte DTBs; `exynos7580_{drm,decon,dsim}.o` are built and the DTBs contain the
  new compatibles.
- Hardware-untested. Keep the vendor fbdev driver as the fallback until a real
  modeset is validated on the phone.

## Userspace gap packages

New pmaports packages, all pulled in by `device-samsung-j7elte` depends:

| Package | Gap | Status |
|---|---|---|
| `j7elte-audio-ucm` | UCM2 routing/mixer for COD3022X (54/54 controls validated) | implemented |
| `j7elte-audio-jack` | `sec_jack` uevent -> UCM2 speaker/headphone/headset-mic routing | implemented |
| `j7elte-wifi` | wpa_supplicant template, `/efs/wifi` MAC provisioning | implemented |
| `j7elte-bt` | rfkill + hciattach + bluetoothd service, BCM43438A1.hcd | implemented |
| `j7elte-sensors` | K2HH/CM36672P/STK3013 to `net.hadess.SensorProxy`; D-Bus UNIX_FDS fix | implemented |
| `j7elte-power` | power_supply/UPower integration, capacity_max restore | implemented |
| `j7elte-fde` | unl0kr/fbdev initramfs integration for FDE | implemented |
| `j7elte-gpu-soft` | Mesa llvmpipe + Xorg fbdev software GL (installed by device package) | implemented (software only) |
| `j7elte-gpsd` | BCM4752 power + NMEA forwarder + first BRI handshake frames | partial: SW flow-control step unresolved |
| `j7elte-cam` | V4L2 capture + optional AE/AWB metadata loop | implemented (basic capture + AE; no JPEG/3A HAL) |
| `j7elte-cbd` | CP boot loader for `/dev/umts_boot0` | partial: RIL layer blocked |
| `j7elte-ril` | SIPC5 transport, IMEI, SIM lock, network state | partial: calls/SMS/data not implemented |
| `firmware-samsung-j7elte` | Wi-Fi/BT/FIMC-IS/MFC blobs | implemented |

Details and test plans are in `parity/reports/*-userspace.md`.

## Second-round verification

- 18 pmaports patches (firmware, kernel config, all userspace packages, RIL,
  audio jack, the dependent sensor D-Bus fix, and device deps) apply cleanly in
  order to a fresh `ba682bd` worktree.
- Combined kernel build with camera + Bluetooth + DRM patches and the DRM config
  fragment: `BUILD_EXIT=0`, `Image` 17,545,608 B, three DTBs.
- The built Image contains the camera `request_firmware` fallback and the
  `samsung,exynos7580-decon-drm` compatible; the built DTB routes `bluetooth`
  pinctrl to `gpc4-2` and contains the DRM display compatibles.
- Verification is static plus cross-build; no phone was available for runtime tests.

## Remaining blockers

- **GPU / 3D (hardware)**: the target is the Nura 3.10 **kbase** kernel, not
  mainline. Panfrost is therefore not the Nura path: it requires mainline DRM
  (absent in 3.10) and mainline has no Exynos7580 support. The Panfrost M0/LPAE
  work is a feasibility artifact only. Chosen path: **Mesa kbase backend** for
  UK10.6 (estimated ~3.5-6 person-months to full GL, vs 6-18 for mainline
  Exynos+Panfrost). First milestone delivered: standalone kbase winsys
  (handshake/SAME_VA/soft-job/event/submit), a panfrost kmod kbase backend, and
  a Gallium screen/context skeleton; the Mesa patches apply to main. Remaining:
  WSI/dma-buf/sync_file, full Mesa link (needs LLVM/mesa_clc), Midgard chain
  validation and hardware bring-up. No GL rendering is claimed.
  This avoids the r7p0->r15p0 UAPI shim, the 32-bit bionic runtime, libhybris,
  gralloc/HWC and the Android blob. The archived alternatives were ARM's r15p0
  Linux DDK (closed/absent) and the Android-blob libhybris path; a blob
  decompilation inventory remains as reference. The blob track proved the blob
  loads under a freestanding ELF32 loader (106,993 relocations, constructors,
  EGL display creation) and its submit path is 32 B/56 B atom (r7p0) vs the
  kernel's 40 B/64 B (r15p0), but it stops at gralloc/ion//dev/mali0.
  Software GL is installed by the device package (llvmpipe + Xorg fbdev); it is
  not Mali acceleration.
- **Telephony (calls/SMS/data)**: `j7elte-cbd` boots the CP and `j7elte-ril`
  implements the protocol-41 SIPC5 client: IMEI, SIM/PIN status, network
  registration, SMS device-ready, radio/modem power. The SIPC5 link/FMT framing
  and transport codec are reverse-engineered in `parity/userspace/ril/sipc5/`.
  The 415-subcommand catalog is in `parity/userspace/ril/spec/messages.md`.
  Implemented: call originate (variant A), answer, release, list, hold, DTMF,
  flash and voice-privacy; SMS SMSC get/set; GPRS define-PDP and PS-attach.
  Remaining: SMS submit/PDU, PDP SET/get, call-list upload, call modify/time,
  E911/SRVCC/block/transfer/manage-call, and SND audio path.
- **GPS**: power/NMEA forwarding and the first BRI handshake frames (autobaud,
  `Bri_GetOutOfLegacy`, `Bri_RequestHwVersion`, `Bri_RequestDebugSfr`) are
  implemented byte-exact from the ROM binary; the sequence stops at Broadcom's
  SW flow-control search, which needs a hardware UART capture.
- **Camera**: basic capture + optional AE/AWB metadata loop; JPEG and the full
  3A HAL are not implemented.
- **Display**: the DRM/KMS driver compiles; a hardware modeset is still untested.

## Notes

- The original stock zip remains at `/home/asdf/Downloads/SAMFW.COM_SM-J700M_PCW_J700MUBU2BRC2_fac.zip`.
- 218 scratch entries moved from `/tmp` to `session/tmp-artifacts/` (see `MANIFEST.txt`).
- Verification is static plus cross-build; no runtime test on the phone was possible here.

# j7elte ROM <-> Nura driver parity session

Working directory for the Samsung Galaxy J7 (2015) `SM-J700M` (`j7elte`, Exynos 7580)
kernel driver parity work between the stock Android ROM and Nura (formerly postmarketOS).

## Device / sources

- Stock ROM: `SM-J700M` `J700MUBU2BRC2`, Android 6.0.1, kernel `3.10.61-13213628`.
- ROM kernel: raw arm64 `Image`, all drivers built in (no `.ko` modules),
  55,634 kallsyms symbols recovered.
- Nura kernel: `LineageOS/android_kernel_samsung_universal7580` @ `2a746c1`,
  downstream 3.10.108, baseline commit `b5e363a`. Nura is **not** mainline for this device.
- Upstream reference: Linux 7.3 (kernel.org), used only for the parity survey.

## Layout

```
boot.img, recovery.img, system.img, system.raw   extracted ROM images
AP_J700MUBU2BRC2_..._user_low_ship.tar.md5       AP tar (extracted from the stock zip)
boot_out/                                        kernel.bin, vmlinux.elf, symbols.txt, dtbs/
android_kernel_samsung_universal7580-.../         Nura kernel tree (clean baseline)
linux-7.3/, linux-7.3.tar.xz                      upstream reference
toolchains/                                       GCC 10.3 aarch64 toolchain
config-nura-j7elte                                Nura build config (pristine)
lineage-kernel.tar.gz                             Nura kernel source archive
tools/                                            boot image / config comparison helpers
session/tmp-artifacts/                            scratch files moved out of /tmp
parity/                                           all deliverables (see below)
```

`parity/`:

```
patches/          7 exported patches (kernel + pmaports)
reports/          14 per-driver reports (P1-P4 evidence)
firmware/         extracted ROM blobs + per-driver file lists + MANIFEST.sha512
pmaports/         pmaports baseline ba682bd + uncommitted integration changes
build-src/        kernel worktree with build patches + parity kernel patches applied
out/              built Image and rev00/rev04/rev06 DTBs
build.sh          kernel build script (GCC 10.3)
verify.sh         applies every patch with git apply --check against the baselines
contract.md       parity definition and evidence rules
*.log             baseline / camera / final build logs
```

## Patches

Kernel (apply to the baseline kernel tree, commit `b5e363a`):

1. `parity/patches/bluetooth/0001-j7elte-bt-pinctrl.patch`
   - BT enable pin was `gpa1-6`; ROM uses `gpc4-2` on all three board revisions.
2. `parity/patches/camera/0001-fimc-is2-fallback-to-request_firmware-for-fw-version-check.patch`
   - FIMC-IS firmware version check hard-failed on `/system/vendor/firmware`;
     add a `request_firmware()` fallback so `/lib/firmware` works.
3. `parity/patches/drm/0001-drm-exynos7580-decon-dsim-kms.patch`
   - new `drivers/gpu/drm/exynos7580/` KMS driver (DECON + DSIM + ea8061).
4. `parity/patches/drm/0002-arm64-dts-exynos7580-j7elte-drm-display.patch`
   - DT compatibles for the DRM driver on rev00/04/06.

pmaports (apply in this order to `parity/pmaports`, baseline `ba682bd`):

5. `parity/patches/wifi/0001-j7elte-wifi-firmware-paths.patch`
   - `BCMDHD_FW_PATH` / `BCMDHD_NVRAM_PATH` -> `/lib/firmware/postmarketos/samsung-j7elte/`.
6. `parity/patches/bluetooth/0002-j7elte-bt-hci-config.patch`
   - enable `CONFIG_BT_HCIUART` + `CONFIG_BT_HCIUART_H4` for BlueZ.
7. `parity/patches/pmaports/0003-firmware-samsung-j7elte-package.patch`
   - new `firmware-samsung-j7elte` package (Wi-Fi, BT, FIMC-IS, MFC blobs).
8. `parity/patches/pmaports/0005-linux-samsung-j7elte-config-sha512.patch`
   - updated config checksum after the two config changes.
9. `parity/patches/userspace/0001-device-deps.patch`
   - `device-samsung-j7elte` depends on the firmware and all userspace packages.
10. `parity/patches/userspace/audio/0002-j7elte-audio-ucm-package.patch`
11. `parity/patches/userspace/connectivity/0001-j7elte-wifi-package.patch`
12. `parity/patches/userspace/connectivity/0002-j7elte-bt-package.patch`
13. `parity/patches/userspace/sensors/0001-add-j7elte-sensors-package.patch`
14. `parity/patches/userspace/battery/0001-pmaports-add-j7elte-power-package.patch`
15. `parity/patches/userspace/gps/0001-pmaports-add-j7elte-gpsd-package.patch`
16. `parity/patches/userspace/ril/0001-j7elte-cbd-package.patch`
17. `parity/patches/userspace/camera/0001-pmaports-add-j7elte-cam-package.patch`
18. `parity/patches/userspace/fde/0001-j7elte-fde-package.patch`
19. `parity/patches/userspace/gpu/0001-j7elte-gpu-soft-package.patch`
   - software GL (Mesa llvmpipe + Xorg fbdev); pulled in by the device package.
20. `parity/patches/userspace/audio/0003-j7elte-audio-jack-package.patch`
21. `parity/patches/userspace/ril/0002-j7elte-ril-package.patch`

Dependent/optional patches:
- `parity/patches/userspace/review-a/0001-j7elte-sensors-ignore-unknown-dbus-header-fields.patch`
  (apply after `sensors/0001`; required for GDBus clients)
- `parity/patches/userspace/gpu-panfrost/0001-arm64-dts-exynos7580-add-mali-t720-compatible.patch`
  (optional kernel DT string for a future Panfrost driver; kbase still binds)
- `parity/patches/gpu-mesa-kbase/000{1,2,3}-*.patch`
  (Mesa source patches: panfrost kmod kbase backend, JM submit, screen/context
  skeleton; apply to Mesa main, not pmaports/kernel)

The GPS daemon source is also exported as
`parity/patches/userspace/gps/0002-userspace-add-j7elte-gpsd-source.patch`
(source tree; `verify.sh` skips it because it targets `parity/userspace/`).

DRM config fragment (opt-in, used for the final build):
`parity/patches/drm/config-drm-exynos7580.fragment`.

Verify everything:

```
cd parity
./verify.sh          # 22 patches OK; 5 skipped (source-tree, dependent fix, Mesa patches)

#!/bin/sh
# Apply the kbase winsys patches to a Mesa checkout (27.0.0-devel era).
#
#   ./apply.sh /path/to/mesa [branch]
#
# The patches add:
#   0001  src/panfrost/lib/kmod/kbase_kmod.c  (pan_kmod kbase backend, UK 10.6)
#   0002  backend-neutral JM context/submit in the Gallium driver
#   0003  panfrost-kbase-skeleton bring-up executable
#
# The standalone winsys library tested without Mesa lives in
# parity/userspace/gpu/kbase-winsys/; the Mesa backend is self-contained so
# the driver does not depend on that tree.
set -eu

mesa=${1:?usage: apply.sh /path/to/mesa [branch]}
branch=${2:-kbase-winsys}

here=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")" && pwd)

cd "$mesa"
git checkout -B "$branch"
for p in "$here"/000*.patch; do
	echo "applying $(basename "$p")"
	git am --3way "$p"
done

echo
echo "build (host, no OpenCL/LLVM):"
echo "  meson setup build -Dgallium-drivers=panfrost -Dvulkan-drivers= \\"
echo "    -Dplatforms= -Dglx=disabled -Degl=disabled -Dgbm=disabled \\"
echo "    -Dopengl=false -Dgles1=disabled -Dgles2=disabled -Dllvm=disabled \\"
echo "    -Dpanfrost-rust=false -Dbuild-tests=true"
echo "  ninja -C build src/panfrost/lib/kbase-kmod-selftest"

# kbase winsys (UK 10.6) for the Panfrost Gallium driver.
#
#   make                 build the static library + selftest for the host
#   make aarch64         cross-build (aarch64-linux-gnu-gcc or CROSS_COMPILE)
#   make check-abi       verify the GPU-props layout against the kernel headers
#   make check           run the host selftest (exit 2 = no /dev/maliN, OK)
#
# The kbase client (kbase.c/kbase_uapi.h) is reused from ../kbase, which is
# the ABI-verified reference for this kernel.

CC ?= cc
CROSS_COMPILE ?=
AARCH64_CC ?= $(if $(CROSS_COMPILE),$(CROSS_COMPILE)gcc,aarch64-linux-gnu-gcc)

KERNEL_DIR ?= /run/media/asdf/30620d0d-1e41-4d55-af08-b4de2fb9c517/j7elte-session/android_kernel_samsung_universal7580-2a746c1bc1a41eae05988c153f527c8a5dc72d07
R15P0 := $(KERNEL_DIR)/drivers/gpu/arm/t7xx/r15p0

KBASE_DIR := ../kbase
INCLUDES := -Iinclude -I$(KBASE_DIR)

CFLAGS ?= -O2 -g
CFLAGS += -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -Wno-unused-parameter -D_GNU_SOURCE \
          -D_POSIX_C_SOURCE=200809L
LDFLAGS ?=
LDLIBS := -lpthread

LIB_SRCS := src/kbase_winsys.c $(KBASE_DIR)/kbase.c
LIB_OBJS := $(LIB_SRCS:%.c=build/%.o)
LIB := build/libkbase-winsys.a

SELFTEST := build/kbw-selftest
AARCH64_LIB := build-aarch64/libkbase-winsys.a
AARCH64_SELFTEST := build-aarch64/kbw-selftest

.PHONY: all lib aarch64 check check-abi clean

all: lib $(SELFTEST)

lib: $(LIB)

$(LIB): $(LIB_OBJS)
	@mkdir -p $(dir $@)
	$(AR) rcs $@ $^

build/%.o: %.c
	@mkdir -p $(dir $@)
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) $(INCLUDES) -c $< -o $@

$(SELFTEST): tests/kbw-selftest.c $(LIB)
	@mkdir -p $(dir $@)
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) $(INCLUDES) $< $(LIB) $(LDFLAGS) $(LDLIBS) -o $@

aarch64: $(AARCH64_SELFTEST)

$(AARCH64_LIB): $(LIB_SRCS)
	@mkdir -p $(dir $@)
	$(AARCH64_CC) $(CFLAGS) $(INCLUDES) -c src/kbase_winsys.c -o build-aarch64/kbase_winsys.o
	$(AARCH64_CC) $(CFLAGS) $(INCLUDES) -c $(KBASE_DIR)/kbase.c -o build-aarch64/kbase.o
	$(AR) rcs $@ build-aarch64/kbase_winsys.o build-aarch64/kbase.o

$(AARCH64_SELFTEST): tests/kbw-selftest.c $(AARCH64_LIB)
	@mkdir -p $(dir $@)
	$(AARCH64_CC) $(CFLAGS) $(INCLUDES) $< $(AARCH64_LIB) -static $(LDLIBS) -o $@
	@command -v aarch64-linux-gnu-strip >/dev/null 2>&1 && \
		aarch64-linux-gnu-strip $@ || true

check: $(SELFTEST)
	@$(SELFTEST) --print-abi
	@$(SELFTEST); rc=$$?; \
	 if [ $$rc -eq 2 ]; then echo "no device: ABI checks only (expected on this host)"; exit 0; fi; \
	 exit $$rc

# The GPU-props layout in src/kbase_winsys.c is asserted at compile time; this
# regenerates the numbers from the kernel's own headers so drift is visible.
check-abi:
	@test -f "$(R15P0)/mali_base_kernel.h" || { echo "kernel headers not found: $(R15P0)" >&2; exit 1; }
	@mkdir -p build
	$(CC) -std=c11 -Wall -I"$(R15P0)" tools/kbw-props-layout.c -o build/kbw-props-layout
	@build/kbw-props-layout > build/props-layout.txt
	@echo "--- measured from $(R15P0) ---"

# Hardware 3D continuation handoff — Mesa on kbase

Status: 2026-10-25. Target: **Nura 3.10 kernel with kbase** (UK 10.6 / r15p0),
Mali-T720 MP2 on Exynos 7580 (`j7elte`).

Chosen path: **Mesa Gallium Panfrost with a kbase winsys**.
Not Panfrost/DRM (mainline-only; 3.10 lacks DRM and mainline has no Exynos7580).
Not the Android blob/libhybris path (archived; blocked by 32-bit bionic and the
r7p0/r15p0 UAPI split).

## 1. Artifacts and exact state

| Path | State |
|---|---|
| `parity/userspace/gpu/kbase-winsys/` | Standalone winsys, 1,258-line `kbase_winsys.c`; API covers device/screen/context/BO/fence/submit/soft-dump. Builds host and aarch64. |
| `parity/userspace/gpu/kbase/` | ABI-verified kbase UAPI client (`kbase.c`, `kbase_uapi.h`, `kbase-selftest`). Use this as the KMD reference. |
| `parity/userspace/gpu/mesa/src/` | Mesa 27 checkout, branch `kbase-winsys`; commits `35d495f` (kmod backend), `6167ac8` (backend-neutral JM submit), `4d56405` (screen/context skeleton), base `02f1337`. |
| `parity/patches/gpu-mesa-kbase/` | `0001` kmod backend (1,871 lines), `0002` JM submit (55), `0003` skeleton (148), `apply.sh`. Apply with `./apply.sh /path/to/mesa`. |
| `parity/reports/gpu-mesa-kbase.md` | Full milestone report, integration map and remaining-work list. |
| `parity/reports/gpu-kbase.md`, `gpu-re.md`, `mali-blob-re.md` | UAPI mapping, blob evidence/limits, estimator inputs. |

Static facts from the last audit:

- No `/dev/mali0` on this host; **no GPU path has been executed**.
- `build-kbase` is configured with `egl/gles1/gles2/gbm/glx = disabled`,
  `opengl=false`, `vulkan-drivers=[]`, `llvm=disabled`, `mesa-clc=system`.
- `build-kbase/src/gallium/drivers/panfrost/libpanfrost.a` is a ~5 KB stub,
  not a full driver; the full `libgallium_dri`/EGL has **not** been linked.
- `libpan` (Panfrost OpenCL) is pulled in by `with_gallium_panfrost` and needs
  `mesa_clc`. `mesa_clc` is missing; LLVM 20 exists at `/usr/lib/llvm20` but
  there is no `llvm-config` on PATH.
- Winsys `make check-abi` passes; the no-device selftest currently returns 1
  (treat as "no /dev/mali0"; the Makefile `check` treats 2 as expected).
- Mesa patches apply to main (`git am --3way`); skeleton object compiles;
  `kbase-kmod-selftest` links and rejects `/dev/null`.

## 2. Definition of done

**Code complete (shortest visible path):** a full aarch64 Mesa build links
`libgallium_dri`, `libEGL`, `libGLESv2`; Panfrost Gallium uses the kbase winsys;
synchronous submit and event wait work in code; EGL surfaceless works; an fbdev
WSI can present by CPU-mapping a linear BO and blitting to `/dev/fb0`; unit
tests and a mock kbase device cover the ioctl sequences. No hardware claim.

**Not included initially:** dma-buf export/import, sync_file interop,
Wayland/GBM, compositor-quality fences. Those need kernel work (kbase has no
dma-buf fd import; fences are Android sync fences) and are the 6–10 week path.

## 3. Blockers in priority order

1. **Build/link blocker.** `libpan`/`mesa_clc`. Two options:
   - build `mesa_clc` from the Mesa tree with LLVM (needs `llvm-config`), or
   - add a local Mesa patch that skips `subdir('libpan')` for the GL-only build
     (it is OpenCL-only; the GL path never calls it).
   Then enable `-Degl=enabled -Dgles2=enabled` and build the full driver.
2. **Winsys/sync.** Complete event→fence mapping, BO/VM lifetime, coherency
   (SAME_VA, `BASE_MEM_COHERENT_SYSTEM`, cache maintenance). Defer dma-buf.
3. **Renderer submission.** Wire Gallium Panfrost batch/chain, tiler heap,
   uniforms, framebuffer to `kbw_submit`; validate with a headless triangle.
4. **WSI.** `EGL_PLATFORM_SURFACELESS_MESA` first; then fbdev CPU blit.
5. **Hardware.** `/dev/mali0` required for real validation; no emulator.

## 4. Five-agent split (disjoint ownership)

| Agent | Owns | Deliverable / acceptance |
|---|---|---|
| A. `mesa-build` | `parity/patches/gpu-mesa-kbase/` (new 0004+), Mesa meson config | Full `libgallium_dri` + `libEGL`/`libGLESv2` link with EGL/GLES2 enabled; build log; `libpan` skipped or `mesa_clc` built. |
| B. `kbase-winsys-sync` | `parity/userspace/gpu/kbase-winsys/` | Event→fence, BO/VM, coherency; `make check`/selftest; no hardware claim. |
| C. `midgard-submit` | Mesa `src/gallium/drivers/panfrost/{pan_jm,pan_job,pan_cmdstream,pan_screen}.c` | JM submit through the kbase backend; headless triangle path; compile/link. |
| D. `wsi-fbdev` | Mesa `src/egl/`, new `platform_kbase_fbdev` | Surfaceless EGL, then fbdev blit; `eglinfo`/`es2_info` static/documentation. |
| E. `integration-tests` | `parity/userspace/gpu/tests/`, `check-state.sh`, mock kbase | Mock `/dev/mali0` (LD_PRELOAD/ioctl mock), unit tests, CI script; no source overlap. |

One integration owner merges Mesa branches; agents must not edit the same Mesa
files concurrently. Use `git worktree` for separate Mesa checkouts.

## 5. Commands

Winsys:

```
cd parity/userspace/gpu/kbase-winsys
make clean all
make check-abi
./tests/kbw-selftest --print-abi
./tests/kbw-selftest          # no device: expects non-zero
make aarch64
```

Mesa:

```
cd parity/userspace/gpu/mesa/src
# patches already applied on branch kbase-winsys; reapply with:
#   ../../../patches/gpu-mesa-kbase/apply.sh .
meson setup build-kbase -Dgallium-drivers=panfrost -Dvulkan-drivers= \
  -Dplatforms= -Dglx=disabled -Degl=disabled -Dgbm=disabled -Dopengl=false \
  -Dgles1=disabled -Dgles2=disabled -Dllvm=disabled -Dpanfrost-rust=false \
  -Dbuild-tests=true
ninja -C build-kbase \
  src/panfrost/lib/kbase-kmod-selftest \
  src/gallium/drivers/panfrost/libpanfrost.a
```

For the full driver, change to `-Degl=enabled -Dgles2=enabled`, resolve
`libpan`/`mesa_clc`, and build `src/gallium/targets/dri` (or the EGL/GLES
targets).

## 6. Hardware test plan (when a phone is available)

1. Boot the Nura kernel with kbase; confirm `/dev/mali0` and no kbase errors in
   `dmesg`.
2. Run `parity/userspace/gpu/kbase/kbase-selftest` (handshake/alloc/soft job).
3. Run `kbw-selftest` with no args (handshake, SAME_VA, event).
4. `eglinfo -B`, `es2_info` with surfaceless; then the fbdev WSI test.
5. `glmark2-es2 --off-screen` (if packaged); capture dmesg on any hang.
6. Suspend/resume, multi-context, forced job fault (if the kernel supports it).

## 7. Do not

- Do not switch to Panfrost/DRM: that is mainline-only and not the Nura target.
- Do not enable both the vendor fbdev display stack and a DRM display stack.
- Do not claim GL/rendering without the hardware test.
- Do not add dma-buf/sync_file dependencies to the first milestone; they are
  kernel-limited and not needed for the shortest visible path.

# j7elte ROM <-> Nura driver parity session

Working directory for the Samsung Galaxy J7 (2015) `SM-J700M` (`j7elte`, Exynos 7580)
kernel driver parity work between the stock Android ROM and Nura (formerly postmarketOS).

## Device / sources

- Stock ROM: `SM-J700M` `J700MUBU2BRC2`, Android 6.0.1, kernel `3.10.61-13213628`.
- ROM kernel: raw arm64 `Image`, all drivers built in (no `.ko` modules),
  55,634 kallsyms symbols recovered.
- Nura kernel: `LineageOS/android_kernel_samsung_universal7580` @ `2a746c1`,
  downstream 3.10.108, baseline commit `b5e363a`. Nura is **not** mainline for this device.
- Upstream reference: Linux 7.3 (kernel.org), used only for the parity survey.

## Layout

```
boot.img, recovery.img, system.img, system.raw   extracted ROM images
AP_J700MUBU2BRC2_..._user_low_ship.tar.md5       AP tar (extracted from the stock zip)
boot_out/                                        kernel.bin, vmlinux.elf, symbols.txt, dtbs/
android_kernel_samsung_universal7580-.../         Nura kernel tree (clean baseline)
linux-7.3/, linux-7.3.tar.xz                      upstream reference
toolchains/                                       GCC 10.3 aarch64 toolchain
config-nura-j7elte                                Nura build config (pristine)
lineage-kernel.tar.gz                             Nura kernel source archive
tools/                                            boot image / config comparison helpers
session/tmp-artifacts/                            scratch files moved out of /tmp
parity/                                           all deliverables (see below)
```

`parity/`:

```
patches/          7 exported patches (kernel + pmaports)
reports/          14 per-driver reports (P1-P4 evidence)
firmware/         extracted ROM blobs + per-driver file lists + MANIFEST.sha512
pmaports/         pmaports baseline ba682bd + uncommitted integration changes
build-src/        kernel worktree with build patches + parity kernel patches applied
out/              built Image and rev00/rev04/rev06 DTBs
build.sh          kernel build script (GCC 10.3)
verify.sh         applies every patch with git apply --check against the baselines
contract.md       parity definition and evidence rules
*.log             baseline / camera / final build logs
```

## Patches

Kernel (apply to the baseline kernel tree, commit `b5e363a`):

1. `parity/patches/bluetooth/0001-j7elte-bt-pinctrl.patch`
   - BT enable pin was `gpa1-6`; ROM uses `gpc4-2` on all three board revisions.
2. `parity/patches/camera/0001-fimc-is2-fallback-to-request_firmware-for-fw-version-check.patch`

  for those families.

- `parity/patches/drm/0001-drm-exynos7580-decon-dsim-kms.patch`

## Second-round verification

  pinctrl to `gpc4-2` and contains the DRM display compatibles.
- Verification is static plus cross-build; no phone was available for runtime tests.

## Remaining blockers

- **GPU / 3D (hardware)**: the target is the Nura 3.10 **kbase** kernel, not
  mainline. Panfrost is therefore not the Nura path: it requires mainline DRM
  (absent in 3.10) and mainline has no Exynos7580 support. The Panfrost M0/LPAE
  work is a feasibility artifact only. Chosen path: **Mesa kbase backend** for
  UK10.6 (estimated ~3.5-6 person-months to full GL, vs 6-18 for mainline
  Exynos+Panfrost). First milestone delivered: standalone kbase winsys

  validation and hardware bring-up. No GL rendering is claimed.
  This avoids the r7p0->r15p0 UAPI shim, the 32-bit bionic runtime, libhybris,
  gralloc/HWC and the Android blob. The archived alternatives were ARM's r15p0
  Linux DDK (closed/absent) and the Android-blob libhybris path; a blob
  decompilation inventory remains as reference. The blob track proved the blob
  loads under a freestanding ELF32 loader (106,993 relocations, constructors,
  EGL display creation) and its submit path is 32 B/56 B atom (r7p0) vs the
  kernel's 40 B/64 B (r15p0), but it stops at gralloc/ion//dev/mali0.
  Software GL is installed by the device package (llvmpipe + Xorg fbdev); it is
  not Mali acceleration.
- **Telephony (calls/SMS/data)**: `j7elte-cbd` boots the CP and `j7elte-ril`
  implements the protocol-41 SIPC5 client: IMEI, SIM/PIN status, network
  registration, SMS device-ready, radio/modem power. The SIPC5 link/FMT framing
  and transport codec are reverse-engineered in `parity/userspace/ril/sipc5/`.
  The 415-subcommand catalog is in `parity/userspace/ril/spec/messages.md`.
  Implemented: full protocol-41 client; calls (originate A/B, answer, release,
  list, hold, DTMF, flash, voice privacy, modify/time, E911/SRVCC/block/
  transfer/manage-call, call-list upload, SND audio); SMS (SMSC, text send via
  GSM 03.40 encoder, read/delete/ack, auto-ack, incoming parser, SIM write);
  GPRS (define-PDP, PDP activate/deactivate/actions, PS-attach, IPv6,
  mobile-data).
  Remaining edge: multi-part SMS/UDH/UCS2, TPDU field decoding, IpcHistory
  response matching, LTE profile, call-list W4/E911 RAT/state-word. No hardware
  validation of any frame.
- **GPS**: power/NMEA forwarding and the first BRI handshake frames (autobaud,
  `Bri_GetOutOfLegacy`, `Bri_RequestHwVersion`, `Bri_RequestDebugSfr`) are
  implemented byte-exact from the ROM binary; the sequence stops at Broadcom's
  SW flow-control search, which needs a hardware UART capture.
- **Camera**: basic capture + optional AE/AWB metadata loop; JPEG and the full
  3A HAL are not implemented.
- **Display**: the DRM/KMS driver compiles; a hardware modeset is still untested.

details.oldText:
# j7elte ROM <-> Nura driver parity session

Working directory for the Samsung Galaxy J7 (2015) `SM-J700M` (`j7elte`, Exynos 7580)
kernel driver parity work between the stock Android ROM and Nura (formerly postmarketOS).

## Device / sources

- Stock ROM: `SM-J700M` `J700MUBU2BRC2`, Android 6.0.1, kernel `3.10.61-13213628`.
- ROM kernel: raw arm64 `Image`, all drivers built in (no `.ko` modules),
  55,634 kallsyms symbols recovered.
- Nura kernel: `LineageOS/android_kernel_samsung_universal7580` @ `2a746c1`,
  downstream 3.10.108, baseline commit `b5e363a`. Nura is **not** mainline for this device.
- Upstream reference: Linux 7.3 (kernel.org), used only for the parity survey.

## Layout

```
boot.img, recovery.img, system.img, system.raw   extracted ROM images
AP_J700MUBU2BRC2_..._user_low_ship.tar.md5       AP tar (extracted from the stock zip)
boot_out/                                        kernel.bin, vmlinux.elf, symbols.txt, dtbs/
android_kernel_samsung_universal7580-.../         Nura kernel tree (clean baseline)
linux-7.3/, linux-7.3.tar.xz                      upstream reference
toolchains/                                       GCC 10.3 aarch64 toolchain
config-nura-j7elte                                Nura build config (pristine)
lineage-kernel.tar.gz                             Nura kernel source archive
tools/                                            boot image / config comparison helpers
session/tmp-artifacts/                            scratch files moved out of /tmp
parity/                                           all deliverables (see below)
```

`parity/`:

```
patches/          7 exported patches (kernel + pmaports)
reports/          14 per-driver reports (P1-P4 evidence)
firmware/         extracted ROM blobs + per-driver file lists + MANIFEST.sha512
pmaports/         pmaports baseline ba682bd + uncommitted integration changes
build-src/        kernel worktree with build patches + parity kernel patches applied
out/              built Image and rev00/rev04/rev06 DTBs
build.sh          kernel build script (GCC 10.3)
verify.sh         applies every patch with git apply --check against the baselines
contract.md       parity definition and evidence rules
*.log             baseline / camera / final build logs
```

## Patches

Kernel (apply to the baseline kernel tree, commit `b5e363a`):

1. `parity/patches/bluetooth/0001-j7elte-bt-pinctrl.patch`
   - BT enable pin was `gpa1-6`; ROM uses `gpc4-2` on all three board revisions.
2. `parity/patches/camera/0001-fimc-is2-fallback-to-request_firmware-for-fw-version-check.patch`
   - FIMC-IS firmware version check hard-failed on `/system/vendor/firmware`;
     add a `request_firmware()` fallback so `/lib/firmware` works.
3. `parity/patches/drm/0001-drm-exynos7580-decon-dsim-kms.patch`
   - new `drivers/gpu/drm/exynos7580/` KMS driver (DECON + DSIM + ea8061).
4. `parity/patches/drm/0002-arm64-dts-exynos7580-j7elte-drm-display.patch`
   - DT compatibles for the DRM driver on rev00/04/06.

pmaports (apply in this order to `parity/pmaports`, baseline `ba682bd`):

5. `parity/patches/wifi/0001-j7elte-wifi-firmware-paths.patch`
   - `BCMDHD_FW_PATH` / `BCMDHD_NVRAM_PATH` -> `/lib/firmware/postmarketos/samsung-j7elte/`.
6. `parity/patches/bluetooth/0002-j7elte-bt-hci-config.patch`
   - enable `CONFIG_BT_HCIUART` + `CONFIG_BT_HCIUART_H4` for BlueZ.
7. `parity/patches/pmaports/0003-firmware-samsung-j7elte-package.patch`
   - new `firmware-samsung-j7elte` package (Wi-Fi, BT, FIMC-IS, MFC blobs).
8. `parity/patches/pmaports/0005-linux-samsung-j7elte-config-sha512.patch`
   - updated config checksum after the two config changes.
9. `parity/patches/userspace/0001-device-deps.patch`
   - `device-samsung-j7elte` depends on the firmware and all userspace packages.
10. `parity/patches/userspace/audio/0002-j7elte-audio-ucm-package.patch`
11. `parity/patches/userspace/connectivity/0001-j7elte-wifi-package.patch`
12. `parity/patches/userspace/connectivity/0002-j7elte-bt-package.patch`
13. `parity/patches/userspace/sensors/0001-add-j7elte-sensors-package.patch`
14. `parity/patches/userspace/battery/0001-pmaports-add-j7elte-power-package.patch`
15. `parity/patches/userspace/gps/0001-pmaports-add-j7elte-gpsd-package.patch`
16. `parity/patches/userspace/ril/0001-j7elte-cbd-package.patch`
17. `parity/patches/userspace/camera/0001-pmaports-add-j7elte-cam-package.patch`
18. `parity/patches/userspace/fde/0001-j7elte-fde-package.patch`
19. `parity/patches/userspace/gpu/0001-j7elte-gpu-soft-package.patch`
   - software GL (Mesa llvmpipe + Xorg fbdev); pulled in by the device package.
20. `parity/patches/userspace/audio/0003-j7elte-audio-jack-package.patch`
21. `parity/patches/userspace/ril/0002-j7elte-ril-package.patch`

Dependent/optional patches:
- `parity/patches/userspace/review-a/0001-j7elte-sensors-ignore-unknown-dbus-header-fields.patch`
  (apply after `sensors/0001`; required for GDBus clients)
- `parity/patches/userspace/gpu-panfrost/0001-arm64-dts-exynos7580-add-mali-t720-compatible.patch`
  (optional kernel DT string for a future Panfrost driver; kbase still binds)
- `parity/patches/gpu-mesa-kbase/000{1,2,3}-*.patch`
  (Mesa source patches: panfrost kmod kbase backend, JM submit, screen/context
  skeleton; apply to Mesa main, not pmaports/kernel)

The GPS daemon source is also exported as
`parity/patches/userspace/gps/0002-userspace-add-j7elte-gpsd-source.patch`
(source tree; `verify.sh` skips it because it targets `parity/userspace/`).

DRM config fragment (opt-in, used for the final build):
`parity/patches/drm/config-drm-exynos7580.fragment`.

Verify everything:

```
cd parity
./verify.sh          # 22 patches OK; 5 skipped (source-tree, dependent fix, Mesa patches)
```

## Build

Base build (vendor fbdev display, camera + BT patches):

```
./parity/build.sh parity/build-src parity/out Image dtbs
```

# j7elte ROM <-> Nura driver parity session

Working directory for the Samsung Galaxy J7 (2015) `SM-J700M` (`j7elte`, Exynos 7580)
kernel driver parity work between the stock Android ROM and Nura (formerly postmarketOS).

Full session handoff: `parity/HANDOFF-SESSION.md`.
Hardware-3D continuation: `parity/HANDOFF-3D.md`.

## Device / sources

- Stock ROM: `SM-J700M` `J700MUBU2BRC2`, Android 6.0.1, kernel `3.10.61-13213628`.
- ROM kernel: raw arm64 `Image`, all drivers built in (no `.ko` modules),
  55,634 kallsyms symbols recovered.
- Nura kernel: `LineageOS/android_kernel_samsung_universal7580` @ `2a746c1`,
  downstream 3.10.108, baseline commit `b5e363a`. Nura is **not** mainline for this device.
- Upstream reference: Linux 7.3 (kernel.org), used only for the parity survey.

## Layout

```
boot.img, recovery.img, system.img, system.raw   extracted ROM images
AP_J700MUBU2BRC2_..._user_low_ship.tar.md5       AP tar (extracted from the stock zip)
boot_out/                                        kernel.bin, vmlinux.elf, symbols.txt, dtbs/
android_kernel_samsung_universal7580-.../         Nura kernel tree (clean baseline)
linux-7.3/, linux-7.3.tar.xz                      upstream reference
toolchains/                                       GCC 10.3 aarch64 toolchain
config-nura-j7elte                                Nura build config (pristine)
lineage-kernel.tar.gz                             Nura kernel source archive
tools/                                            boot image / config comparison helpers
session/tmp-artifacts/                            scratch files moved out of /tmp
parity/                                           all deliverables (see below)
```

`parity/`:

```
patches/          7 exported patches (kernel + pmaports)
reports/          14 per-driver reports (P1-P4 evidence)
firmware/         extracted ROM blobs + per-driver file lists + MANIFEST.sha512
pmaports/         pmaports baseline ba682bd + uncommitted integration changes
build-src/        kernel worktree with build patches + parity kernel patches applied
out/              built Image and rev00/rev04/rev06 DTBs
build.sh          kernel build script (GCC 10.3)
verify.sh         applies every patch with git apply --check against the baselines
contract.md       parity definition and evidence rules
*.log             baseline / camera / final build logs
```

## Patches

Kernel (apply to the baseline kernel tree, commit `b5e363a`):

1. `parity/patches/bluetooth/0001-j7elte-bt-pinctrl.patch`
   - BT enable pin was `gpa1-6`; ROM uses `gpc4-2` on all three board revisions.
2. `parity/patches/camera/0001-fimc-is2-fallback-to-request_firmware-for-fw-version-check.patch`
   - FIMC-IS firmware version check hard-failed on `/system/vendor/firmware`;
     add a `request_firmware()` fallback so `/lib/firmware` works.
3. `parity/patches/drm/0001-drm-exynos7580-decon-dsim-kms.patch`
   - new `drivers/gpu/drm/exynos7580/` KMS driver (DECON + DSIM + ea8061).
4. `parity/patches/drm/0002-arm64-dts-exynos7580-j7elte-drm-display.patch`
   - DT compatibles for the DRM driver on rev00/04/06.

pmaports (apply in this order to `parity/pmaports`, baseline `ba682bd`):

5. `parity/patches/wifi/0001-j7elte-wifi-firmware-paths.patch`
   - `BCMDHD_FW_PATH` / `BCMDHD_NVRAM_PATH` -> `/lib/firmware/postmarketos/samsung-j7elte/`.
6. `parity/patches/bluetooth/0002-j7elte-bt-hci-config.patch`
   - enable `CONFIG_BT_HCIUART` + `CONFIG_BT_HCIUART_H4` for BlueZ.
7. `parity/patches/pmaports/0003-firmware-samsung-j7elte-package.patch`
   - new `firmware-samsung-j7elte` package (Wi-Fi, BT, FIMC-IS, MFC blobs).
8. `parity/patches/pmaports/0005-linux-samsung-j7elte-config-sha512.patch`
   - updated config checksum after the two config changes.
9. `parity/patches/userspace/0001-device-deps.patch`
   - `device-samsung-j7elte` depends on the firmware and all userspace packages.
10. `parity/patches/userspace/audio/0002-j7elte-audio-ucm-package.patch`
11. `parity/patches/userspace/connectivity/0001-j7elte-wifi-package.patch`
12. `parity/patches/userspace/connectivity/0002-j7elte-bt-package.patch`
13. `parity/patches/userspace/sensors/0001-add-j7elte-sensors-package.patch`
14. `parity/patches/userspace/battery/0001-pmaports-add-j7elte-power-package.patch`
15. `parity/patches/userspace/gps/0001-pmaports-add-j7elte-gpsd-package.patch`
16. `parity/patches/userspace/ril/0001-j7elte-cbd-package.patch`
17. `parity/patches/userspace/camera/0001-pmaports-add-j7elte-cam-package.patch`
18. `parity/patches/userspace/fde/0001-j7elte-fde-package.patch`
19. `parity/patches/userspace/gpu/0001-j7elte-gpu-soft-package.patch`
   - software GL (Mesa llvmpipe + Xorg fbdev); pulled in by the device package.
20. `parity/patches/userspace/audio/0003-j7elte-audio-jack-package.patch`
21. `parity/patches/userspace/ril/0002-j7elte-ril-package.patch`

Dependent/optional patches:
- `parity/patches/userspace/review-a/0001-j7elte-sensors-ignore-unknown-dbus-header-fields.patch`
  (apply after `sensors/0001`; required for GDBus clients)
- `parity/patches/userspace/gpu-panfrost/0001-arm64-dts-exynos7580-add-mali-t720-compatible.patch`
  (optional kernel DT string for a future Panfrost driver; kbase still binds)
- `parity/patches/gpu-mesa-kbase/000{1,2,3}-*.patch`
  (Mesa source patches: panfrost kmod kbase backend, JM submit, screen/context
  skeleton; apply to Mesa main, not pmaports/kernel)

The GPS daemon source is also exported as
`parity/patches/userspace/gps/0002-userspace-add-j7elte-gpsd-source.patch`
(source tree; `verify.sh` skips it because it targets `parity/userspace/`).

DRM config fragment (opt-in, used for the final build):
`parity/patches/drm/config-drm-exynos7580.fragment`.

Verify everything:

```
cd parity
./verify.sh          # 22 patches OK; 5 skipped (source-tree, dependent fix, Mesa patches)
```

## Build

Base build (vendor fbdev display, camera + BT patches):

```
./parity/build.sh parity/build-src parity/out Image dtbs
```

Result: `BUILD_EXIT=0`, Image 17,365,040 B, three j7elte DTBs under `parity/out/`.

Final combined build (adds the DRM/KMS driver; opt-in config):

```
CFG=parity/final-config ./parity/build.sh parity/final-kernel-check parity/final-out Image dtbs
```

- `parity/final-kernel-check` is a clean `b5e363a` worktree with the pmaports
  build patches (GCC 10, fix-argb, sun/Solaris flag, etc.) plus the Bluetooth,
  camera and DRM kernel patches.
- `parity/final-config` is the WiFi/BT kernel config plus
  `parity/patches/drm/config-drm-exynos7580.fragment` (DRM, 32 MB CMA, vendor
  fbdev display path disabled).
- Result: `BUILD_EXIT=0`, Image **17,545,608 B**, three j7elte DTBs under
  `parity/final-out/`, `exynos7580_{drm,decon,dsim}.o` built, camera fallback
  and BT `gpc4-2` group present in the outputs.

Keep the vendor fbdev path as the fallback; do not enable both display stacks
at once.

## Firmware package

`parity/pmaports/device/archived/firmware-samsung-j7elte/` contains:

- `APKBUILD` (deterministic `firmware.tar.gz`, sha512 pinned)
- `extract-firmware.sh` (rebuilds the tarball from the stock AP tar; verifies `files.sha512`)
- `files.sha512` (per-blob checksums)

Install destinations:

- `/lib/firmware/postmarketos/samsung-j7elte/` - bcmdhd firmware/NVRAM, BT HCD
- `/lib/firmware/` - `fimc_is_fw2_3l2.bin`, `setfile_3l2.bin`, `setfile_5e3.bin`,
  `fimc_is_fd.bin`, `mfc_fw.bin`

## Kernel driver parity (first round)

- 11 driver families at parity: display, battery, audio, sensors, storage, touch,
  USB, GPS, GPU, platform (thermal/devfreq/IOMMU/cpufreq), modem.
- 3 driver families patched: Wi-Fi (config), Bluetooth (DT + config), camera (driver fallback).
- The ROM's driver set is already present in the Nura fork; no driver code was missing
  for those families.

## New DRM/KMS driver (display)

- `parity/patches/drm/0001-drm-exynos7580-decon-dsim-kms.patch`
  adds `drivers/gpu/drm/exynos7580/` (DECON CRTC/plane, DSIM encoder/connector,
  ea8061 panel init, dumb buffers + fbdev).
- `parity/patches/drm/0002-arm64-dts-exynos7580-j7elte-drm-display.patch`
  adds `samsung,exynos7580-decon-drm` / `samsung,exynos7580-dsim` to rev00/04/06.
- `parity/patches/drm/config-drm-exynos7580.fragment` enables DRM,
  `CONFIG_DRM_EXYNOS7580`, 32 MB CMA, and disables the vendor fbdev display path.
- Verified build: `parity/final-out/arch/arm64/boot/Image` (17,545,608 B) + three
  j7elte DTBs; `exynos7580_{drm,decon,dsim}.o` are built and the DTBs contain the
  new compatibles.
- Hardware-untested. Keep the vendor fbdev driver as the fallback until a real
  modeset is validated on the phone.

## Userspace gap packages

New pmaports packages, all pulled in by `device-samsung-j7elte` depends:

| Package | Gap | Status |
|---|---|---|
| `j7elte-audio-ucm` | UCM2 routing/mixer for COD3022X (54/54 controls validated) | implemented |
| `j7elte-audio-jack` | `sec_jack` uevent -> UCM2 speaker/headphone/headset-mic routing | implemented |
| `j7elte-wifi` | wpa_supplicant template, `/efs/wifi` MAC provisioning | implemented |
| `j7elte-bt` | rfkill + hciattach + bluetoothd service, BCM43438A1.hcd | implemented |
| `j7elte-sensors` | K2HH/CM36672P/STK3013 to `net.hadess.SensorProxy`; D-Bus UNIX_FDS fix | implemented |
| `j7elte-power` | power_supply/UPower integration, capacity_max restore | implemented |
| `j7elte-fde` | unl0kr/fbdev initramfs integration for FDE | implemented |
| `j7elte-gpu-soft` | Mesa llvmpipe + Xorg fbdev software GL (installed by device package) | implemented (software only) |
| `j7elte-gpsd` | BCM4752 power + NMEA forwarder + first BRI handshake frames | partial: SW flow-control step unresolved |
| `j7elte-cam` | V4L2 capture + optional AE/AWB metadata loop | implemented (basic capture + AE; no JPEG/3A HAL) |
| `j7elte-cbd` | CP boot loader for `/dev/umts_boot0` | partial: RIL layer blocked |
| `j7elte-ril` | SIPC5 transport, IMEI, SIM lock, network state | partial: calls/SMS/data not implemented |
| `firmware-samsung-j7elte` | Wi-Fi/BT/FIMC-IS/MFC blobs | implemented |

Details and test plans are in `parity/reports/*-userspace.md`.

## Second-round verification

- 18 pmaports patches (firmware, kernel config, all userspace packages, RIL,
  audio jack, the dependent sensor D-Bus fix, and device deps) apply cleanly in
  order to a fresh `ba682bd` worktree.
- Combined kernel build with camera + Bluetooth + DRM patches and the DRM config
  fragment: `BUILD_EXIT=0`, `Image` 17,545,608 B, three DTBs.
- The built Image contains the camera `request_firmware` fallback and the
  `samsung,exynos7580-decon-drm` compatible; the built DTB routes `bluetooth`
  pinctrl to `gpc4-2` and contains the DRM display compatibles.
- Verification is static plus cross-build; no phone was available for runtime tests.

## Remaining blockers

- **GPU / 3D (hardware)**: the target is the Nura 3.10 **kbase** kernel, not
  mainline. Panfrost is therefore not the Nura path: it requires mainline DRM
  (absent in 3.10) and mainline has no Exynos7580 support. The Panfrost M0/LPAE
  work is a feasibility artifact only. Chosen path: **Mesa kbase backend** for
  UK10.6 (estimated ~3.5-6 person-months to full GL, vs 6-18 for mainline
  Exynos+Panfrost). First milestone delivered: standalone kbase winsys
  (handshake/SAME_VA/soft-job/event/submit), a panfrost kmod kbase backend, and
  a Gallium screen/context skeleton; the Mesa patches apply to main. Remaining:
  WSI/dma-buf/sync_file, full Mesa link (needs LLVM/mesa_clc), Midgard chain
  validation and hardware bring-up. No GL rendering is claimed.
  This avoids the r7p0->r15p0 UAPI shim, the 32-bit bionic runtime, libhybris,
  gralloc/HWC and the Android blob. The archived alternatives were ARM's r15p0
  Linux DDK (closed/absent) and the Android-blob libhybris path; a blob
  decompilation inventory remains as reference. The blob track proved the blob
  loads under a freestanding ELF32 loader (106,993 relocations, constructors,
  EGL display creation) and its submit path is 32 B/56 B atom (r7p0) vs the
  kernel's 40 B/64 B (r15p0), but it stops at gralloc/ion//dev/mali0.
  Software GL is installed by the device package (llvmpipe + Xorg fbdev); it is
  not Mali acceleration. Continuation handoff for the next agent:
  `parity/HANDOFF-3D.md` (state, build blockers, 5-agent split, test plan).
- **Telephony (calls/SMS/data)**: `j7elte-cbd` boots the CP and `j7elte-ril`
  implements the protocol-41 SIPC5 client: IMEI, SIM/PIN status, network
  registration, SMS device-ready, radio/modem power. The SIPC5 link/FMT framing
  and transport codec are reverse-engineered in `parity/userspace/ril/sipc5/`.
  The 415-subcommand catalog is in `parity/userspace/ril/spec/messages.md`.
  Implemented: full protocol-41 client; calls (originate A/B, answer, release,
  list, hold, DTMF, flash, voice privacy, modify/time, E911/SRVCC/block/
  transfer/manage-call, call-list upload, SND audio); SMS (SMSC, text send via
  GSM 03.40 encoder, read/delete/ack, auto-ack, incoming parser, SIM write);
  GPRS (define-PDP, PDP activate/deactivate/actions, PS-attach, IPv6,
  mobile-data).
  Remaining edge: multi-part SMS/UDH/UCS2, TPDU field decoding, IpcHistory
  response matching, LTE profile, call-list W4/E911 RAT/state-word. No hardware
  validation of any frame.
- **GPS**: power/NMEA forwarding and the first BRI handshake frames (autobaud,
  `Bri_GetOutOfLegacy`, `Bri_RequestHwVersion`, `Bri_RequestDebugSfr`) are
  implemented byte-exact from the ROM binary; the sequence stops at Broadcom's
  SW flow-control search, which needs a hardware UART capture.
- **Camera**: basic capture + optional AE/AWB metadata loop; JPEG and the full
  3A HAL are not implemented.
- **Display**: the DRM/KMS driver compiles; a hardware modeset is still untested.

## Notes

- The original stock zip remains at `/home/asdf/Downloads/SAMFW.COM_SM-J700M_PCW_J700MUBU2BRC2_fac.zip`.
- 218 scratch entries moved from `/tmp` to `session/tmp-artifacts/` (see `MANIFEST.txt`).
- Verification is static plus cross-build; no runtime test on the phone was possible here.

# j7elte ROM <-> Nura driver parity session

Working directory for the Samsung Galaxy J7 (2015) `SM-J700M` (`j7elte`, Exynos 7580)
kernel driver parity work between the stock Android ROM and Nura (formerly postmarketOS).

Full session handoff: `parity/HANDOFF-SESSION.md`.
Hardware-3D continuation: `parity/HANDOFF-3D.md`.

## Device / sources

- Stock ROM: `SM-J700M` `J700MUBU2BRC2`, Android 6.0.1, kernel `3.10.61-13213628`.
- ROM kernel: raw arm64 `Image`, all drivers built in (no `.ko` modules),
  55,634 kallsyms symbols recovered.
- Nura kernel: `LineageOS/android_kernel_samsung_universal7580` @ `2a746c1`,
  downstream 3.10.108, baseline commit `b5e363a`. Nura is **not** mainline for this device.
- Upstream reference: Linux 7.3 (kernel.org), used only for the parity survey.

## Layout

```
input/SAMFW.COM_SM-J700M_..._fac.zip              original stock ROM zip
boot.img, recovery.img, system.img, system.raw   extracted ROM images
AP_J700MUBU2BRC2_..._user_low_ship.tar.md5       AP tar (extracted from the stock zip)
boot_out/                                        kernel.bin, vmlinux.elf, symbols.txt, dtbs/
android_kernel_samsung_universal7580-.../         Nura kernel tree (clean baseline)
linux-7.3/, linux-7.3.tar.xz                      upstream reference
toolchains/                                       GCC 10.3 aarch64 toolchain
config-nura-j7elte                                Nura build config (pristine)
lineage-kernel.tar.gz                             Nura kernel source archive
tools/                                            boot image / config comparison helpers
session/tmp-artifacts/                            initial /tmp scratch files
session/tmp-artifacts-late/                       late /tmp build artifacts
parity/                                           all deliverables (see below)
```

`parity/`:

```
patches/          7 exported patches (kernel + pmaports)
reports/          14 per-driver reports (P1-P4 evidence)
firmware/         extracted ROM blobs + per-driver file lists + MANIFEST.sha512
pmaports/         pmaports baseline ba682bd + uncommitted integration changes
build-src/        kernel worktree with build patches + parity kernel patches applied
out/              built Image and rev00/rev04/rev06 DTBs
build.sh          kernel build script (GCC 10.3)
verify.sh         applies every patch with git apply --check against the baselines
contract.md       parity definition and evidence rules
*.log             baseline / camera / final build logs
```

## Patches

Kernel (apply to the baseline kernel tree, commit `b5e363a`):

1. `parity/patches/bluetooth/0001-j7elte-bt-pinctrl.patch`
   - BT enable pin was `gpa1-6`; ROM uses `gpc4-2` on all three board revisions.
2. `parity/patches/camera/0001-fimc-is2-fallback-to-request_firmware-for-fw-version-check.patch`
   - FIMC-IS firmware version check hard-failed on `/system/vendor/firmware`;
     add a `request_firmware()` fallback so `/lib/firmware` works.
3. `parity/patches/drm/0001-drm-exynos7580-decon-dsim-kms.patch`
   - new `drivers/gpu/drm/exynos7580/` KMS driver (DECON + DSIM + ea8061).
4. `parity/patches/drm/0002-arm64-dts-exynos7580-j7elte-drm-display.patch`
   - DT compatibles for the DRM driver on rev00/04/06.

pmaports (apply in this order to `parity/pmaports`, baseline `ba682bd`):

5. `parity/patches/wifi/0001-j7elte-wifi-firmware-paths.patch`
   - `BCMDHD_FW_PATH` / `BCMDHD_NVRAM_PATH` -> `/lib/firmware/postmarketos/samsung-j7elte/`.
6. `parity/patches/bluetooth/0002-j7elte-bt-hci-config.patch`
   - enable `CONFIG_BT_HCIUART` + `CONFIG_BT_HCIUART_H4` for BlueZ.
7. `parity/patches/pmaports/0003-firmware-samsung-j7elte-package.patch`
   - new `firmware-samsung-j7elte` package (Wi-Fi, BT, FIMC-IS, MFC blobs).
8. `parity/patches/pmaports/0005-linux-samsung-j7elte-config-sha512.patch`
   - updated config checksum after the two config changes.
9. `parity/patches/userspace/0001-device-deps.patch`
   - `device-samsung-j7elte` depends on the firmware and all userspace packages.
10. `parity/patches/userspace/audio/0002-j7elte-audio-ucm-package.patch`
11. `parity/patches/userspace/connectivity/0001-j7elte-wifi-package.patch`
12. `parity/patches/userspace/connectivity/0002-j7elte-bt-package.patch`
13. `parity/patches/userspace/sensors/0001-add-j7elte-sensors-package.patch`
14. `parity/patches/userspace/battery/0001-pmaports-add-j7elte-power-package.patch`
15. `parity/patches/userspace/gps/0001-pmaports-add-j7elte-gpsd-package.patch`
16. `parity/patches/userspace/ril/0001-j7elte-cbd-package.patch`
17. `parity/patches/userspace/camera/0001-pmaports-add-j7elte-cam-package.patch`
18. `parity/patches/userspace/fde/0001-j7elte-fde-package.patch`
19. `parity/patches/userspace/gpu/0001-j7elte-gpu-soft-package.patch`
   - software GL (Mesa llvmpipe + Xorg fbdev); pulled in by the device package.
20. `parity/patches/userspace/audio/0003-j7elte-audio-jack-package.patch`
21. `parity/patches/userspace/ril/0002-j7elte-ril-package.patch`

Dependent/optional patches:
- `parity/patches/userspace/review-a/0001-j7elte-sensors-ignore-unknown-dbus-header-fields.patch`
  (apply after `sensors/0001`; required for GDBus clients)
- `parity/patches/userspace/gpu-panfrost/0001-arm64-dts-exynos7580-add-mali-t720-compatible.patch`
  (optional kernel DT string for a future Panfrost driver; kbase still binds)
- `parity/patches/gpu-mesa-kbase/000{1,2,3}-*.patch`
  (Mesa source patches: panfrost kmod kbase backend, JM submit, screen/context
  skeleton; apply to Mesa main, not pmaports/kernel)

The GPS daemon source is also exported as
`parity/patches/userspace/gps/0002-userspace-add-j7elte-gpsd-source.patch`
(source tree; `verify.sh` skips it because it targets `parity/userspace/`).

DRM config fragment (opt-in, used for the final build):
`parity/patches/drm/config-drm-exynos7580.fragment`.

Verify everything:

```
cd parity
./verify.sh          # 22 patches OK; 5 skipped (source-tree, dependent fix, Mesa patches)
```

## Build

Base build (vendor fbdev display, camera + BT patches):

```
./parity/build.sh parity/build-src parity/out Image dtbs
```

Result: `BUILD_EXIT=0`, Image 17,365,040 B, three j7elte DTBs under `parity/out/`.

Final combined build (adds the DRM/KMS driver; opt-in config):

```
CFG=parity/final-config ./parity/build.sh parity/final-kernel-check parity/final-out Image dtbs
```

- `parity/final-kernel-check` is a clean `b5e363a` worktree with the pmaports
  build patches (GCC 10, fix-argb, sun/Solaris flag, etc.) plus the Bluetooth,
  camera and DRM kernel patches.
- `parity/final-config` is the WiFi/BT kernel config plus
  `parity/patches/drm/config-drm-exynos7580.fragment` (DRM, 32 MB CMA, vendor
  fbdev display path disabled).
- Result: `BUILD_EXIT=0`, Image **17,545,608 B**, three j7elte DTBs under
  `parity/final-out/`, `exynos7580_{drm,decon,dsim}.o` built, camera fallback
  and BT `gpc4-2` group present in the outputs.

Keep the vendor fbdev path as the fallback; do not enable both display stacks
at once.

## Firmware package

`parity/pmaports/device/archived/firmware-samsung-j7elte/` contains:

- `APKBUILD` (deterministic `firmware.tar.gz`, sha512 pinned)
- `extract-firmware.sh` (rebuilds the tarball from the stock AP tar; verifies `files.sha512`)
- `files.sha512` (per-blob checksums)

Install destinations:

- `/lib/firmware/postmarketos/samsung-j7elte/` - bcmdhd firmware/NVRAM, BT HCD
- `/lib/firmware/` - `fimc_is_fw2_3l2.bin`, `setfile_3l2.bin`, `setfile_5e3.bin`,
  `fimc_is_fd.bin`, `mfc_fw.bin`

## Kernel driver parity (first round)

- 11 driver families at parity: display, battery, audio, sensors, storage, touch,
  USB, GPS, GPU, platform (thermal/devfreq/IOMMU/cpufreq), modem.
- 3 driver families patched: Wi-Fi (config), Bluetooth (DT + config), camera (driver fallback).
- The ROM's driver set is already present in the Nura fork; no driver code was missing
  for those families.

## New DRM/KMS driver (display)

- `parity/patches/drm/0001-drm-exynos7580-decon-dsim-kms.patch`
  adds `drivers/gpu/drm/exynos7580/` (DECON CRTC/plane, DSIM encoder/connector,
  ea8061 panel init, dumb buffers + fbdev).
- `parity/patches/drm/0002-arm64-dts-exynos7580-j7elte-drm-display.patch`
  adds `samsung,exynos7580-decon-drm` / `samsung,exynos7580-dsim` to rev00/04/06.
- `parity/patches/drm/config-drm-exynos7580.fragment` enables DRM,
  `CONFIG_DRM_EXYNOS7580`, 32 MB CMA, and disables the vendor fbdev display path.
- Verified build: `parity/final-out/arch/arm64/boot/Image` (17,545,608 B) + three
  j7elte DTBs; `exynos7580_{drm,decon,dsim}.o` are built and the DTBs contain the
  new compatibles.
- Hardware-untested. Keep the vendor fbdev driver as the fallback until a real
  modeset is validated on the phone.

## Userspace gap packages

New pmaports packages, all pulled in by `device-samsung-j7elte` depends:

| Package | Gap | Status |
|---|---|---|
| `j7elte-audio-ucm` | UCM2 routing/mixer for COD3022X (54/54 controls validated) | implemented |
| `j7elte-audio-jack` | `sec_jack` uevent -> UCM2 speaker/headphone/headset-mic routing | implemented |
| `j7elte-wifi` | wpa_supplicant template, `/efs/wifi` MAC provisioning | implemented |
| `j7elte-bt` | rfkill + hciattach + bluetoothd service, BCM43438A1.hcd | implemented |
| `j7elte-sensors` | K2HH/CM36672P/STK3013 to `net.hadess.SensorProxy`; D-Bus UNIX_FDS fix | implemented |
| `j7elte-power` | power_supply/UPower integration, capacity_max restore | implemented |
| `j7elte-fde` | unl0kr/fbdev initramfs integration for FDE | implemented |
| `j7elte-gpu-soft` | Mesa llvmpipe + Xorg fbdev software GL (installed by device package) | implemented (software only) |
| `j7elte-gpsd` | BCM4752 power + NMEA forwarder + first BRI handshake frames | partial: SW flow-control step unresolved |
| `j7elte-cam` | V4L2 capture + optional AE/AWB metadata loop | implemented (basic capture + AE; no JPEG/3A HAL) |
| `j7elte-cbd` | CP boot loader for `/dev/umts_boot0` | partial: RIL layer blocked |
| `j7elte-ril` | SIPC5 transport, IMEI, SIM lock, network state | partial: calls/SMS/data not implemented |
| `firmware-samsung-j7elte` | Wi-Fi/BT/FIMC-IS/MFC blobs | implemented |

Details and test plans are in `parity/reports/*-userspace.md`.

## Second-round verification

- 18 pmaports patches (firmware, kernel config, all userspace packages, RIL,
  audio jack, the dependent sensor D-Bus fix, and device deps) apply cleanly in
  order to a fresh `ba682bd` worktree.
- Combined kernel build with camera + Bluetooth + DRM patches and the DRM config
  fragment: `BUILD_EXIT=0`, `Image` 17,545,608 B, three DTBs.
- The built Image contains the camera `request_firmware` fallback and the
  `samsung,exynos7580-decon-drm` compatible; the built DTB routes `bluetooth`
  pinctrl to `gpc4-2` and contains the DRM display compatibles.
- Verification is static plus cross-build; no phone was available for runtime tests.

## Remaining blockers

- **GPU / 3D (hardware)**: the target is the Nura 3.10 **kbase** kernel, not
  mainline. Panfrost is therefore not the Nura path: it requires mainline DRM
  (absent in 3.10) and mainline has no Exynos7580 support. The Panfrost M0/LPAE
  work is a feasibility artifact only. Chosen path: **Mesa kbase backend** for
  UK10.6 (estimated ~3.5-6 person-months to full GL, vs 6-18 for mainline
  Exynos+Panfrost). First milestone delivered: standalone kbase winsys
  (handshake/SAME_VA/soft-job/event/submit), a panfrost kmod kbase backend, and
  a Gallium screen/context skeleton; the Mesa patches apply to main. Remaining:
  WSI/dma-buf/sync_file, full Mesa link (needs LLVM/mesa_clc), Midgard chain
  validation and hardware bring-up. No GL rendering is claimed.
  This avoids the r7p0->r15p0 UAPI shim, the 32-bit bionic runtime, libhybris,
  gralloc/HWC and the Android blob. The archived alternatives were ARM's r15p0
  Linux DDK (closed/absent) and the Android-blob libhybris path; a blob
  decompilation inventory remains as reference. The blob track proved the blob
  loads under a freestanding ELF32 loader (106,993 relocations, constructors,
  EGL display creation) and its submit path is 32 B/56 B atom (r7p0) vs the
  kernel's 40 B/64 B (r15p0), but it stops at gralloc/ion//dev/mali0.
  Software GL is installed by the device package (llvmpipe + Xorg fbdev); it is
  not Mali acceleration. Continuation handoff for the next agent:
  `parity/HANDOFF-3D.md` (state, build blockers, 5-agent split, test plan).
- **Telephony (calls/SMS/data)**: `j7elte-cbd` boots the CP and `j7elte-ril`
  implements the protocol-41 SIPC5 client: IMEI, SIM/PIN status, network
  registration, SMS device-ready, radio/modem power. The SIPC5 link/FMT framing
  and transport codec are reverse-engineered in `parity/userspace/ril/sipc5/`.
  The 415-subcommand catalog is in `parity/userspace/ril/spec/messages.md`.
  Implemented: full protocol-41 client; calls (originate A/B, answer, release,
  list, hold, DTMF, flash, voice privacy, modify/time, E911/SRVCC/block/
  transfer/manage-call, call-list upload, SND audio); SMS (SMSC, text send via
  GSM 03.40 encoder, read/delete/ack, auto-ack, incoming parser, SIM write);
  GPRS (define-PDP, PDP activate/deactivate/actions, PS-attach, IPv6,
  mobile-data).
  Remaining edge: multi-part SMS/UDH/UCS2, TPDU field decoding, IpcHistory
  response matching, LTE profile, call-list W4/E911 RAT/state-word. No hardware
  validation of any frame.
- **GPS**: power/NMEA forwarding and the first BRI handshake frames (autobaud,
  `Bri_GetOutOfLegacy`, `Bri_RequestHwVersion`, `Bri_RequestDebugSfr`) are
  implemented byte-exact from the ROM binary; the sequence stops at Broadcom's
  SW flow-control search, which needs a hardware UART capture.
- **Camera**: basic capture + optional AE/AWB metadata loop; JPEG and the full
  3A HAL are not implemented.
- **Display**: the DRM/KMS driver compiles; a hardware modeset is still untested.

## Notes

- The original stock zip is at `input/SAMFW.COM_SM-J700M_PCW_J700MUBU2BRC2_fac.zip`
  (moved into the session folder).
- All `/tmp` session scratch is under `session/tmp-artifacts*/` (initial 218
  entries plus the later build artifacts); no session files remain in `/tmp`.
- Verification is static plus cross-build; no runtime test on the phone was possible here.

## README

# omp-archive

Export the **entire** history of an omp session as one zip: the main transcript,
every subagent session (recursively, verbatim), all untruncated tool /
background-job output, live background-job state, and a standalone HTML viewer.

`/export` embeds subagent *entries* in a viewer HTML and `/dump` covers the live
main conversation. Neither ships a subagent's own transcript file, its sibling
tool-output logs, or background-job state. This plugin archives all of it.

## Install

```bash
# local checkout / development (symlinked, edits are live)
omp plugin link /home/asdf/projects/omp-archive

# git
omp plugin install github:<user>/omp-archive

# marketplace (this repo ships .omp-plugin/marketplace.json)
/marketplace add <user>/omp-archive
/marketplace install archive@omp-archive

# one-off
omp --extension /home/asdf/projects/omp-archive
```

## Usage

```
/archive                      # -> ./omp-archive-<session>.zip
/archive /tmp/session.zip
/archive --no-artifacts       # skip the artifact/log tree (smaller zip)
/archive --no-viewer          # skip viewer.html
```

The same operation is exposed as the `export_session_archive` tool so the agent
can archive a session on request.

## What's inside

| Path | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| `manifest.json` | Index of everything below: counts, sizes, subagent list, omissions |
| `session.jsonl` | The main session transcript, byte-for-byte |
| `agents.json` | Live per-agent state captured while the session ran (model, system prompt, tools) |
| `jobs.json` | Background/async jobs: `completed` (recovered from every transcript) plus `live` (running/recent at archive time) |
| `artifacts/` | **Every** file under the session artifact directory, byte-for-byte |
| `viewer.html` | Standalone HTML viewer with all subagent sessions embedded |
| `README.md` | Human-readable index of the archive |

`artifacts/` is the complete record: each subagent's own
`<AgentId>.jsonl` (nested children under `<AgentId>/`), the
`*.bash.log` / `*.eval.log` / `*.read.log` files holding the **full,
untruncated** tool and background-job output that the transcript truncates, and
`*.jsonl.tombstone` kill markers.

## Limits

- **Background jobs.** `jobs.json` lists two sources: `completed` — every
  settled async job recovered from the `async-result` entries of the main and
  subagent transcripts (label, status, duration, output handle) — and `live`,
  the running/recent jobs observed while the extension was loaded. A job's full
  output is in its owning transcript plus the matching `artifacts/*.log`.
- **Subagent system prompts / tool lists** are not persisted by the host, so
  they appear in `agents.json` only for sessions this process observed. Each
  subagent's full *conversation* is always present, verbatim, under `artifacts/`.
- The archive is not redacted: it can contain secrets, raw context, and images.  it doesn't sanitize or redact any private or personally identifyable information, that's left to the LLM so you might want to tell it to do that.
- Paths with spaces are not supported in `/archive` arguments (same parsing as
  `/export`).

# j7elte / SM-J700M — ROM ↔ Nura parity

Public snapshot of a driver-parity investigation for the Samsung Galaxy J7
(2015) **SM-J700M** (`j7elte`, Exynos 7580): stock Android 6.0.1 (kernel
3.10.61) vs Nura 3.10.108 and upstream Linux 7.3.

The short answer from the investigation: the stock ROM's drivers are the
usual Samsung/CAF downstream stack; upstream 7.3 has no Exynos 7580 platform
support. Nura's vendor 3.10.108 tree is the closest working base. Most driver
families are at parity; the gaps were in config/DT/firmware and userspace
bring-up, not missing vendor kernel code.

No phone was connected. Runtime claims below are limited to builds,
cross-compilation, static analysis and emulated selftests.

## Start here

| Path | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| [`docs/HANDOFF-SESSION.md`](docs/HANDOFF-SESSION.md) | Full session handoff: state, commands, next work, ownership |
| [`docs/HANDOFF-3D.md`](docs/HANDOFF-3D.md) | Mesa/kbase hardware-GL continuation |
| [`docs/SESSION-README.md`](docs/SESSION-README.md) | Original session README (deliverables and detailed status) |
| [`docs/reports/`](docs/reports/) | 46 per-subsystem reports with evidence and limits |
| [`patches/`](patches/) | 27 patches + series apply/header files |
| [`code/userspace/`](code/userspace/) | RIL, GPS, camera, sensors, audio, connectivity, GPU sources |
| [`code/pmaports/`](code/pmaports/) | 13 package recipes under `device/archived` |
| [`build/`](build/) | `Image`, 3 DTBs, `System.map`, kernel config, build/verify scripts |
| [`session/`](session/) | Full and no-artifacts omp session archives |

## Result

| Area | State |
| --- | --- |
| Kernel drivers | 11 families verified at parity; 3 patched (Wi-Fi config, Bluetooth DT/config, camera firmware fallback) |
| DRM/KMS | New DECON/DSIM/ea8061 stack; compiled; hardware modeset untested |
| pmaports | 18-patch series; 13 packages; 18/18 apply |
| RIL | Protocol 41 client, call/SMS/PDP core, SIPC5 codec, 415-subcommand catalog; edge messages remain |
| GPS | Power/NMEA + first BRI frames; software flow-control capture blocked |
| Camera | V4L2 capture + AE/AWB metadata loop; no JPEG/full 3A |
| Audio | UCM2 routing + automatic jack routing |
| Sensors / power / Wi-Fi / BT / FDE | Implemented userspace packages |
| GPU | Software GL; Mesa-on-kbase first milestone, not linked |
| Verification | `verify.sh`: 22 OK / 5 skipped / 0 failed; kernel build exit 0, `Image` 17,545,608 B; RIL selftest 44 exact frames |

## Reproduce

```bash
# Session checks
bash build/verify.sh

# Kernel build (paths inside the script point at the original workspace)
bash build/build.sh

# RIL selftest (aarch64 static build)
cd code/pmaports/device/archived/j7elte-ril
aarch64-none-linux-gnu-gcc -std=c11 -D_GNU_SOURCE -O2 -static \
  -o j7elte-ril j7elte-ril.c
qemu-aarch64 ./j7elte-ril selftest
```

## What is not published

To keep this repository code/documentation-only and free of proprietary
Samsung material, it excludes:

- the stock ROM zip, AP tar, `boot.img`, `recovery.img`, `system.img`/`raw`;
- extracted Samsung firmware (`firmware.tar.gz`) and any stock blobs;
- proprietary Mali/EGL (`libGLES_mali.so`) and RIL (`libsec-ril*.so`) binaries;
- full kernel and Mesa source trees, and compiler/build trees.

The patches, reports and userspace sources reference those inputs but do not
contain them.

## Session archives

Both archives are in [`session/`](session/) and attached to the GitHub release:

- `omp-archive-full.zip` (40 MB): main transcript, 63 subagent sessions,
  311 artifact/tool logs, viewer, manifest.
- `omp-archive-noartifacts.zip` (27 MB): transcript + viewer only.

Unzip and open `viewer.html`. The archives are unredacted: they contain local
paths, shell history, research context and personal filenames. They are
published by the owner's request.

## Provenance and licensing

Kernel patches are against GPL-2.0 kernel trees and are GPL-2.0. Upstream code
retains its original license. No additional license is granted for the
session-specific reports, notes or userspace code. Stock Samsung firmware and
proprietary binaries are not included. See [`NOTICE.md`](NOTICE.md).

# j7elte / SM-J700M — ROM ↔ Nura parity

Public snapshot of a driver-parity investigation for the Samsung Galaxy J7
(2015) **SM-J700M** (`j7elte`, Exynos 7580): stock Android 6.0.1 (kernel
3.10.61) vs Nura 3.10.108 and upstream Linux 7.3.

The short answer from the investigation: the stock ROM's drivers are the
usual Samsung/CAF downstream stack; upstream 7.3 has no Exynos 7580 platform
support. Nura's vendor 3.10.108 tree is the closest working base. Most driver
families are at parity; the gaps were in config/DT/firmware and userspace
bring-up, not missing vendor kernel code.

No phone was connected. Runtime claims below are limited to builds,
cross-compilation, static analysis and emulated selftests.

## Start here

| Path | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| [`docs/HANDOFF-SESSION.md`](docs/HANDOFF-SESSION.md) | Full session handoff: state, commands, next work, ownership |
| [`docs/HANDOFF-3D.md`](docs/HANDOFF-3D.md) | Mesa/kbase hardware-GL continuation |
| [`docs/SESSION-README.md`](docs/SESSION-README.md) | Original session README (deliverables and detailed status) |
| [`docs/reports/`](docs/reports/) | 46 per-subsystem reports with evidence and limits |
| [`patches/`](patches/) | 27 patches + series apply/header files |
| [`code/userspace/`](code/userspace/) | RIL, GPS, camera, sensors, audio, connectivity, GPU sources |
| [`code/pmaports/`](code/pmaports/) | 13 package recipes under `device/archived` |
| [`build/`](build/) | `Image`, 3 DTBs, `System.map`, kernel config, build/verify scripts |
| [`session/`](session/) | Full and no-artifacts omp session archives |

## Result

| Area | State |
| --- | --- |
| Kernel drivers | 11 families verified at parity; 3 patched (Wi-Fi config, Bluetooth DT/config, camera firmware fallback) |
| DRM/KMS | New DECON/DSIM/ea8061 stack; compiled; hardware modeset untested |
| pmaports | 18-patch series; 13 packages; 18/18 apply |
| RIL | Protocol 41 client, call/SMS/PDP core, SIPC5 codec, 415-subcommand catalog; edge messages remain |
| GPS | Power/NMEA + first BRI frames; software flow-control capture blocked |
| Camera | V4L2 capture + AE/AWB metadata loop; no JPEG/full 3A |
| Audio | UCM2 routing + automatic jack routing |
| Sensors / power / Wi-Fi / BT / FDE | Implemented userspace packages |
| GPU | Software GL; Mesa-on-kbase first milestone, not linked |
| Verification | `verify.sh`: 22 OK / 5 skipped / 0 failed; kernel build exit 0, `Image` 17,545,608 B; RIL selftest 44 exact frames |

## Reproduce

```bash
# Session checks
bash build/verify.sh

# Kernel build (paths inside the script point at the original workspace)
bash build/build.sh

# RIL selftest (aarch64 static build)
cd code/pmaports/device/archived/j7elte-ril
aarch64-none-linux-gnu-gcc -std=c11 -D_GNU_SOURCE -O2 -static \
  -o j7elte-ril j7elte-ril.c
qemu-aarch64 ./j7elte-ril selftest
```

## What is not published

To keep this repository code/documentation-only and free of proprietary
Samsung material, it excludes:

- the stock ROM zip, AP tar, `boot.img`, `recovery.img`, `system.img`/`raw`;
- extracted Samsung firmware (`firmware.tar.gz`) and any stock blobs;
- proprietary Mali/EGL (`libGLES_mali.so`) and RIL (`libsec-ril*.so`) binaries;
- full kernel and Mesa source trees, and compiler/build trees.

The patches, reports and userspace sources reference those inputs but do not
contain them.

## Session archives

Both archives are in [`session/`](session/) and attached to the GitHub release:

- `omp-archive-full.zip` (40 MB): main transcript, 63 subagent sessions,
  311 artifact/tool logs, viewer, manifest.
- `omp-archive-noartifacts.zip` (27 MB): transcript + viewer only.

Unzip and open `viewer.html`. The archives are unredacted: they contain local
paths, shell history, research context and personal filenames. They are
published by the owner's request.

## Provenance and licensing

Kernel patches are against GPL-2.0 kernel trees and are GPL-2.0. Upstream code
retains its original license. No additional license is granted for the
session-specific reports, notes or userspace code. Stock Samsung firmware and
proprietary binaries are not included. See [`NOTICE.md`](NOTICE.md).

details.oldText:
# j7elte / SM-J700M — ROM ↔ Nura parity

Public snapshot of a driver-parity investigation for the Samsung Galaxy J7
(2015) **SM-J700M** (`j7elte`, Exynos 7580): stock Android 6.0.1 (kernel
3.10.61) vs Nura 3.10.108 and upstream Linux 7.3.

The short answer from the investigation: the stock ROM's drivers are the
usual Samsung/CAF downstream stack; upstream 7.3 has no Exynos 7580 platform
support. Nura's vendor 3.10.108 tree is the closest working base. Most driver
families are at parity; the gaps were in config/DT/firmware and userspace
bring-up, not missing vendor kernel code.

No phone was connected. Runtime claims below are limited to builds,
cross-compilation, static analysis and emulated selftests.

## Start here

| Path | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| [`docs/HANDOFF-SESSION.md`](docs/HANDOFF-SESSION.md) | Full session handoff: state, commands, next work, ownership |
| [`docs/HANDOFF-3D.md`](docs/HANDOFF-3D.md) | Mesa/kbase hardware-GL continuation |
| [`docs/SESSION-README.md`](docs/SESSION-README.md) | Original session README (deliverables and detailed status) |
| [`docs/reports/`](docs/reports/) | 46 per-subsystem reports with evidence and limits |
| [`patches/`](patches/) | 27 patches + series apply/header files |
| [`code/userspace/`](code/userspace/) | RIL, GPS, camera, sensors, audio, connectivity, GPU sources |
| [`code/pmaports/`](code/pmaports/) | 13 package recipes under `device/archived` |
| [`build/`](build/) | `Image`, 3 DTBs, `System.map`, kernel config, build/verify scripts |
| [`session/`](session/) | Full and no-artifacts omp session archives |

## Result

| Area | State |
| --- | --- |
| Kernel drivers | 11 families verified at parity; 3 patched (Wi-Fi config, Bluetooth DT/config, camera firmware fallback) |
| DRM/KMS | New DECON/DSIM/ea8061 stack; compiled; hardware modeset untested |
| pmaports | 18-patch series; 13 packages; 18/18 apply |
| RIL | Protocol 41 client, call/SMS/PDP core, SIPC5 codec, 415-subcommand catalog; edge messages remain |
| GPS | Power/NMEA + first BRI frames; software flow-control capture blocked |
| Camera | V4L2 capture + AE/AWB metadata loop; no JPEG/full 3A |
| Audio | UCM2 routing + automatic jack routing |
| Sensors / power / Wi-Fi / BT / FDE | Implemented userspace packages |
| GPU | Software GL; Mesa-on-kbase first milestone, not linked |
| Verification | `verify.sh`: 22 OK / 5 skipped / 0 failed; kernel build exit 0, `Image` 17,545,608 B; RIL selftest 44 exact frames |

## Reproduce

```bash
# Session checks
bash build/verify.sh

# Kernel build (paths inside the script point at the original workspace)
bash build/build.sh

# j7elte / SM-J700M — ROM ↔ Nura parity

Public snapshot of a driver-parity investigation for the Samsung Galaxy J7
(2015) **SM-J700M** (`j7elte`, Exynos 7580): stock Android 6.0.1 (kernel
3.10.61) vs Nura 3.10.108 and upstream Linux 7.3.

The short answer from the investigation: the stock ROM's drivers are the
usual Samsung/CAF downstream stack; upstream 7.3 has no Exynos 7580 platform
support. Nura's vendor 3.10.108 tree is the closest working base. Most driver
families are at parity; the gaps were in config/DT/firmware and userspace
bring-up, not missing vendor kernel code.

No phone was connected. Runtime claims below are limited to builds,
cross-compilation, static analysis and emulated selftests.

## Start here

| --- | --- |
| [`docs/HANDOFF-SESSION.md`](docs/HANDOFF-SESSION.md) | Full session handoff: state, commands, next work, ownership |
